Title: Hydrospace Jetski Cover S4/Pro Edition/S-Pro/Race (05-12) PWC
Description:
Jettribe PWC Cover for Hydrospace Models:

  • S4, Pro Edition, S-Pro, Race Edition (05-12)

 

 

 

Thank you for checking out one of the best PWC covers on the market today. Our Jettribe premium cover offers the most water resistant, water repellent and weather protection for your watercraft, plus our covers are specially built for trailering. Here are some cool features that set our PWC covers above the rest.  We added four 1.5" webbing detachable tie downs, plus we ran shock cord bungee all around the bottom leading edge. For weather resistance, our materials are specially UV coated with the exclusive (CFM) material that is formulated only for Jettribe! It took us nearly two years to figure out the formula! For water resistance, the material is coated with three clear layers of PU backing to keep out water. All our seams are triple stitched and finished off with a binding. No exposed seams! The inside hood area is lined with soft nytex material to protect your PWC's from getting scratched paint. All pin or eye bow areas are reinforced with a tough extra layer of Nylon material. When fueling up, most of our covers have a gas flap opening.  Talk is talk, but seeing is believing! Check out our Jettribe covers online or at your local dealer. They are truly a perfect quality, fit, finish, and a true work of art!

Nice and necessary!
POSTED BY BRYAN A. MUIRHEAD ON 14TH APR 2014
My first solution to getting too much air in my eyes while wearing sunglasses was to get some "over the glasses" goggles. While those worked fine, they sit just a little too high. That prevented me from being able to wear my floppy hat because at speed, the hat would not stay on no matter how tight the lanyard.
So I got these and that problem was solved! Actually both problems described above. Now, the smoked lens isn't quite as good as a pair of high-dollar sunglasses, but you don't really notice unless there is a lot of reflection off of the water.
The other thing that took some getting used to is the shape of the goggles. What I mean is that they seem to be EXACTLY the shape of my eye socket, so it feels strange until you get used to it. But if they were any bigger, my hat would be flying off again. With these, I just tighten down the lanyard, and when the hat feels like it's going to fly off I just pinch the front to shape it into a "V" and we're good to go!
Oh, yeah. Like the other review, one of the bags came with no drawstring. Not a problem for me because I don't store them in the bag.

Title: JTG 10404 JOHN/JACKET WETSUIT
Description: The Jettribe RS-16 John and Jacket Race Suit is built, designed, and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility. Our Jettribe 2011 John and Jacket RS-16John/Jacket RaceSuits are built with strategic placement of 2/3 mm neoprene panels. The 3mm panelsare for the warmth and 2mm panels are built into the high movement areas: the inner arms and legs. We spent a year field testing with our Jettribe Race Team under racing conditions. The results are features like the Jet Grip texture print placed on the inner thigh panels and legs to provide the rider with additional traction while riding. The injected PVC rubber knee pads offer grip and protection. All seams have our interlocking flat stitches to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin. We carefully select just the right combination of thicknesses of neoprene to retain a rider's body heat while riding in various conditions. The RS-16 neoprene's property is a close, high density foam made up of thousands of tiny air bubbles know as cells. These cells provide an insulation barrier which slows down the conduction of heat, allowing the body's heat to be retained. Jettribe RS-16 John/JacketRace Suits are engineered with the understanding of the PWC rider's constant movement which often over-generates body heat. For a example, surf wet suits are designed for a body constantly being in the water. While our Jettribe RS-16 John/JacketRace Suits are designed for the true PWC rider who is both in the water and in the cold air! For the 2010 season, we at Jettribe are proud to present the RS-15 Race Suit! Enjoy Every Ride ! Jettribe Family!

Title: JTG 10405 MOTO TOUR JACKET BLACK
Description:
The Jettribe Moto Tour Jacket is not just a jacket worn in the water. It was designed and specially built for the true PWC rider. With the PWC rider in mind our Jettribe R&D Team built these jackets to provide maximum flexibility, comfort, and various weather protection. Jettribe understands that riders in the past and present have worn the typical tour coat most of the time for some protection and the added "looking cool" factor. Jettribe know function, quality, durability, comfort, and looking cool. They are all to be considered when designing the ultimate riding jacket. Most riders of stand-ups or runabouts experience cold or the chill factor from the wind and water splashes hitting your chest while riding. Our Moto Tour Jacket is designed to keep the cold air away from your core source body heat - which is your chest and head! It's okay if you're wet or damp, but as long as the wind or water does not zap away your body heat. The Moto Tour Jacket is not designed for those riders who find themselves constantly in the water, falling off from their skis. Being above the water - good. In the water - no good! The Moto Tour Jacket's main material is a tough Sato 420 D. Nylon and ballastic Nylon with 2 coats of PU. This provides wind and water resistance. Wind and water are really what gets you cold. 420 D. Nylon is a light and very strong material, plus double stitching for durability. The inside is a mesh liner to keep a layer of air between your skin and the outer shell. This will cut down on the skin irritation. It's like a built in rashguard, and the layer of air will help keep the cold air and water away from you. The Moto Tour Jacket is designed to perform without the thick and heavy insulation. If you want the thick feel, that is what down snow ski jackets are for. The Jettribe Moto Tour Jacket is literally used & abused by many of our Team Riders at the IJSBA World Finals. Yes, these jackets are not just tested, but race tested. The Jettribe Moto Tour Jacket was not meant to replace the wetsuit but it is a great alternative and addition to your wetsuit. It provides the PWC rider with comfort and protection against the elements while looking pretty cool on or out of the water. See you at the next race!!!

  • Tough Sato 420 D. and ballistic nylon with 2 coats of PU for wind and water resistance.
  • Inner mesh liner to keep a layer of air between your skin and the outer layer.
  • Neoprene side panels for warmth and flexibility.
  • Vents to allow air flow, reducing the ballooning effect at high speeds.
  • Mesh armpits to allow water to pass through.

The Jettribe Moto riding pants are designed and specially built for the true PWC rider, not just moto-x pants worn in the water. With the PWC rider in mind, our Jettribe R&D team built these riding pants to provide maximum flexibility, comfort, and protection. Jettribe understands that riders in the past have worn the typical wetsuits most of the time for protection against abrasion while riding their stand-up or runabouts. Traditional wetsuits are ideal for colder riding weather, but riding with wetsuits can be cumbersome, restrictive and hard to get in and out of. Most riders still need the protection against the bumps and bruises while riding. Plus, most of the cold factors that riders experience are from the wind and water splashes from the craft flying across the water (at 65 MPH!), not from being wet. With all of this in mind, Jettribe built the Moto Pants with many features that set our product apart. The knee and shin areas have EVA compression foam molded pads for that added protection. But our high density EVA foam will not absorb water and stays light. The main material is a tough Sato 420 D. nylon with 2 coats of PU. This material is light and very strong, providing wind and water resistance. Wind and water are really what make you cold. In the inseam panel area, we built an air mesh panel to allow water to pass through and allow you to stay light while keeping in your body heat. The rear panel is constructed out of neoprene to allow maximum flexibility. This panel is also embedded with our Jet Grip - a silicone texture to maximize grip from your "butt" to your runabout's seat. The dual side pockets have a built in drain hole on the outside and the inside is mesh. This allows the water to drain straight through. Once again, we built these pants to be light while wet. Our single pull tight system allows for instant belt release or tightening. Just one pull to tighten or one quick press on the 50 MM buckle to release the waist belt. The Jettribe Moto Pants are literally used & abused by many of our team riders at the IJSBA World Finals. Yes, these pants are not only tested, but race tested. The Jettribe Moto Pants are not built to replace the wetsuit but they are a great alternative. Title: Gecko RS-15 Grip Boots PWC Jetski Ride & Race Jet Ski Gear
Description:
Gecko RS-15 Grip Boots PWC Jetski Ride & Race Jet Ski Gear

IF YOU DO NOT SEE YOUR SIZE: PLEASE SEE OUR NEW BOOTS #JTG-15496 OR #JTG-15492

Have you asked for a better riding boot? We at Jettribe have listened. After being on the APBA and IJSBA tour seeing racers and freestyle riders use various shoes from wrestling shoes to skate shoes, we wanted to make a change. We are proud to release our RS-15 Race Boots with Gecko Grip sole!  After careful research and testing, we bring to you a true riding boot that is built around a PWC rider!

To start with, the sole is modeled after the grip pads of a Gecko, with about 433 individual traction pads. These are strategically spaced apart to allow the sole to quickly disperse water between the sole of your boot and the surface of your PWC for instant traction and grip. Soles with flat surfaces tend to trap water between the sole and deck and provide less grip and traction. Second, the RS-15 rubber soles are designed with three raised contact points to accommodate a PWC rider's aggressive stance. Most of the time we ride from the ball of our foot, constantly switching our weight from the heel to our toes. Plus, the pre-curved sole with arch support allows maximum comfort!

The sole wraps around the sides and toes and limits the lateral side to side movement of the rider’s feet. The extra high neoprene cut of the RS-15 boot limits the rocks and gravel from getting in. It has a front zippered entry for easy slip on or off - plus three adjustable velcro straps for a snug and better fit.

We hope that you will ride with better comfort and performance with our RS-15 Race Boot! Enjoy your next ride! 

  • Gecko Grip sole with 433 individual traction pads.
  • Soles are designed with three raised contact points to accommodate a PWC riders aggressive stance.
  • 9 mesh flow through panels allow water to drain quickly. We do not drill a hole on the bottom of soles, like an afterthought.
  • Pre-curved sole with arch support for maximum comfort.

Description:
• 2 piece set: Long John including Jacket.
  • Race proven by the best professional watercraft racers in the world!
  • Engineered for the riders' maximum comfort
  • 3mm neoprene throughtout, 2mm sides.
  • Zippered front jacket.
  • Velcro closer on John shoulder.
  • Seems have interlocking flat stitches to provide watertight seal
  • Great flexibility
  • This wetsuit is designed for the true PWC rider who is both in the water and in the cold air

 

The Jettribe John/Jacket Race Suits are designed, engineered and built for the rider's maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility. Our Jettribe Race Suits are made with strategic placement of 2/3 mm neoprene panels. The 3mm panels are for the warmth and 2mm panels are built into the high movement areas: the inner arms and legs. We spent a year field testing with our Jettribe Race Team under racing conditions. The results are features like the Jet Grip texture print placed on the inner thigh panels and legs to provide the rider with additional traction while riding. The injected PVC rubber knee pads offer grip and protection. All seams have our interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin. We carefully select just the right combination of neoprene thickness to retain the rider's body heat while riding in various conditions. The Race Suit's neoprene's property is a close, high density foam made up of thousands of tiny air bubbles known as cells. These cells provide an insulation barrier which slows down the conduction of heat, allowing the body's heat to be retained. Jettribe John/Jacket Race Suits are engineered with the understanding of the PWC rider's constant movement which often over-generates body heat. For example, surfing wetsuits are designed for a body constantly being in the water. Our John/Jacket Race Suits are designed for the true PWC rider who is both in the water and in the cold air! For the non-racing hard core riders out there this wetsuit far exceeds average standards as the the pro racer is 16 times harder on the wear and tear of their gear.  Jettribe is proud to present the Race Suit! Enjoy every ride!

This wetsuit is worn by the Jettribe USA International Travel Team.  It is also worn by Jettribe Pro Riders:

Title: JTG 11406VB MOTO TOUR JACKET VERTIGO
Description:
The Jettribe Moto Tour Jacket is not just a jacket worn in the water. It was designed and specially built for the true PWC rider. With the PWC rider in mind our Jettribe R&D Team built these jackets to provide maximum flexibility, comfort, and various weather protection. Jettribe understands that riders in the past and present have worn the typical tour coat most of the time for some protection and the added "looking cool" factor. Jettribe know function, quality, durability, comfort, and looking cool. They are all to be considered when designing the ultimate riding jacket. Most riders of stand-ups or runabouts experience cold or the chill factor from the wind and water splashes hitting your chest while riding. Our Moto Tour Jacket is designed to keep the cold air away from your core source body heat - which is your chest and head! It's okay if you're wet or damp, but as long as the wind or water does not zap away your body heat. The Moto Tour Jacket is not designed for those riders who find themselves constantly in the water, falling off from their skis. Being above the water - good. In the water - no good! The Moto Tour Jacket's main material is a tough Sato 420 D. Nylon and ballastic Nylon with 2 coats of PU. This provides wind and water resistance. Wind and water are really what gets you cold. 420 D. Nylon is a light and very strong material, plus double stitching for durability. The inside is a mesh liner to keep a layer of air between your skin and the outer shell. This will cut down on the skin irritation. It's like a built in rashguard, and the layer of air will help keep the cold air and water away from you. The Moto Tour Jacket is designed to perform without the thick and heavy insulation. If you want the thick feel, that is what down snow ski jackets are for. The Jettribe Moto Tour Jacket is literally used & abused by many of our Team Riders at the IJSBA World Finals. Yes, these jackets are not just tested, but race tested. The Jettribe Moto Tour Jacket was not meant to replace the wetsuit but it is a great alternative and addition to your wetsuit. It provides the PWC rider with comfort and protection against the elements while looking pretty cool on or out of the water. See you at the next race!!!

The Jettribe John/Jacket Race Suits are designed, engineered and built for the rider's maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility. Our Jettribe Race Suits are made with strategic placement of 2/3 mm neoprene panels. The 3mm panels are for the warmth and 2mm panels are built into the high movement areas: the inner arms and legs. We spent a year field testing with our Jettribe Race Team under racing conditions. The results are features like the Jet Grip texture print placed on the inner thigh panels and legs to provide the rider with additional traction while riding. The injected PVC rubber knee pads offer grip and protection. All seams have our interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin. We carefully select just the right combination of neoprene thickness to retain the rider's body heat while riding in various conditions. The Race Suit's neoprene's property is a close, high density foam made up of thousands of tiny air bubbles known as cells. Title: JTG 13433 NEO COAT MOTO TOUR JACKET BLACK
Description:
• Tough neoprene for wind and water resistance.
  • Neoprene side panels for warmth and flexibility.
  • Vents to allow air flow, reducing the ballooning effect at high speeds.

The Jettribe Neo Coat is not just a jacket worn in the water. It was designed and specially built for the true PWC rider. With the PWC rider in mind our Jettribe R&D Team built these jackets to provide maximum flexibility, comfort, and various weather protection. Jettribe understands that riders in the past and present have worn the typical tour coat most of the time for some protection and the added "looking cool" factor. Jettribe know function, quality, durability, comfort, and looking cool. They are all to be considered when designing the ultimate riding jacket. Most riders of stand-ups or runabouts experience cold or the chill factor from the wind and water splashes hitting your chest while riding. Our Neo Coat is designed to keep the cold air away from your core source body heat - which is your chest and head! It's okay if you're wet or damp, but as long as the wind or water does not zap away your body heat. The Neo Coat is not designed for those riders who find themselves constantly in the water, falling off from their skis. Being above the water - good. In the water - no good! The Neo Coat's main material is a tough Sato 420 D. Nylon and ballastic Nylon with 2 coats of PU. This provides wind and water resistance. Wind and water are really what gets you cold. 420 D. Nylon is a light and very strong material, plus double stitching for durability. The inside is a mesh liner to keep a layer of air between your skin and the outer shell. This will cut down on the skin irritation. It's like a built in rashguard, and the layer of air will help keep the cold air and water away from you. The Neo Coat is designed to perform without the thick and heavy insulation. If you want the thick feel, that is what down snow ski jackets are for. The Jettribe Neo Coat is literally used & abused by many of our Team Riders at the IJSBA World Finals. Yes, these jackets are not just tested, but race tested. The Jettribe Neo Coat was not meant to replace the wetsuit but it is a great alternative and addition to your wetsuit. It provides the PWC rider with comfort and protection against the elements while looking pretty cool on or out of the water. See you at the next race!!!

Title: C.E. Nato Back Deflector PWC Jetski Ride & Race Jet Ski Gear
Description:
C.E. Nato PWC Back Deflector

  • This back deflector is the ULTIMATE in back protection for racing!
  • IJSBA and TJSBA compliant
  • Hinged Impact Plates
  • Top layer is ABS Panels
  • Polycarbonate Honeycomb inside
  • Fits most side entry vests including: RS-16, RS-17, UR-20, Moto-1, M1-G2, Special Forces vest, Jet Pilot Side entry, QuakySense, Fly Side Entry and more!


PWCs are getting faster and more powerful.  At Jettribe, we believe that the dawn of a new era in PWC watersports is long overdue, and we're striving to pave the way for an evolution.....no, a revolution.....in PWC gear designed specifically for PWC riding.  

This back deflector mounts on the outside of your life jacket with a specially designed velcro system which allows it to fit almost any side entry vest.  Unlike in Motorcross, when your back protector is designed to protect you while landing on the ground and skidding, the PWC back protector is designed to deflect and disperse the impact of another ski as it hits you. The Nato does just that!  It is also designed to drain water and float unlike motorcross back protectors that retain water and make you heavier in the water.    The purpose of wearing this on the outside of the vest is to give you that extra cushion upon impact.

Riders spend thousands of dollars every season to make their skis faster and faster.  The Nato back deflector is the best possible protection you can give yourself.  Don't you think its time to start investing in yourself?  Make sure you buy a back deflector now!  Not when it is too late and you already have an injury to your spine.  Isn't your back worth it?

The Nato is worn by Pro riders James Bushell, Erminio Iantosca, the Thai National Team and The Chinese National Team

Title: Tour Coat Shockwave Moto Jacket Red/Blue PWC Jetski Ride & Race
Description:
Tour Coat Shockwave Moto Jacket Red/Blue 

The Jettribe Neoprene Tour Coat, or Moto Jacket is designed for those chilly days on or off the Water. The tour coat is made as an additional overlayer to help keep your core temperature high, which is primarily in your chest. From our Jettribe professional team riders, most of the “cold factor” is not from getting wet or falling off your ski, it is from the water splashes and cold, high winds which occur when flying across the water at 80 mph. Our Jettribe Tour Coat has some special features: it has an oversized cut to be worn over the lifevest and wetsuit. Most riders’ major complaints about other tour coats are that jackets are heavy and restrict movement. The Jettribe Tour Coat has pre-curved elbow joints for added comfort, and the 5mm neoprene goes through our proprietary compression process to make it 3.5 mil. This gives the material a lighter feel, while providing the same cold protection density as a 5mm. The bold and oversized graphic is printed by a gas fusing process, so that the material is soft and light to the touch without fading or cracking screenprinted logos.

  • Neoprene with 2 sided lycra for wind and water resistance
  • Neoprene side panels for warmth and flexibility

Description:
Tour Coat Shockwave Moto Jacket Black / Yellow 

The Jettribe Neoprene Tour Coat, or Moto Jacket is designed for those chilly days on or off the Water. The tour coat is made as an additional overlayer to help keep your core temperature high, which is primarily in your chest. From our Jettribe professional team riders, most of the “cold factor” is not from getting wet or falling off your ski, it is from the water splashes and cold, high winds which occur when flying across the water at 80 mph. Our Jettribe Tour Coat has some special features: it has an oversized cut to be worn over the lifevest and wetsuit. Most riders’ major complaints about other tour coats are that jackets are heavy and restrict movement. The Jettribe Tour Coat has pre-curved elbow joints for added comfort, and the 5mm neoprene goes through our proprietary compression process to make it 3.5 mil. This gives the material a lighter feel, while providing the same cold protection density as a 5mm. The bold and oversized graphic is printed by a gas fusing process, so that the material is soft and light to the touch without fading or cracking screenprinted logos.

Title: UR-20 Side Entry Vest Black/White PWC Jetski Ride & Race Jacket
Description:
UR-20 Side Entry Vest Shockwave Black/White

Note: The Shockwave series has been discontinued in 2019. No additional sizes will be produced.

The Jettribe UR-20 Side Entry Vest. This vest is an excellent all-around vest for free riding, freestyle, closed course racing, offshore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well.

As of 2017 the Jettribe UR-20 Side Entry Vest has the incorporated pre-molded foam unique only to our Jettribe race vests. What is it? The pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the contour of the rider’s body, instead of forcing a flat piece EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body.  Plus, our second process is heat and pressure compression, this allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2 inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation.

The UR-20 side entry vests utilize an ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. The ink fusion wraps and dyes the color around the yarn and fibers of the materials. This allows for a smooth, soft, feel to the vest.  And, it will never crack or dry out like the screen printed inks.

We are especially proud of the UR-20.  We have taken the best of all vests and built into this one vest.  Every minute detail has been carefully considered.  For example, all of the webbing are tacked down with a zig-zag bar tack, rescue handles are wrapped underneath, then bar tacked, then finished off with a box stitch. All webbing exit openings are reinforced with a TPR collar for durability.  Most of these details are over-looked by others, but not by the Jettribe design team.

Our Jettribe race vests have been proven with top professional racers throughout the world.  Some of the features that separate our vest from the rest are: triple rescue handles, back protection compatible, triple 38mm buckles and webbing , interchangeable velcro flag patches and removable heavy duty PWC lanyard D-ring. Plus, the rear race collar attachment.

Jettribe designed and developed this vest using the best materials available.  We do recommend that riding equipment be replaced every two seasons. If there are any signs of fading, discoloration or drying out of the materials - please, replace it right away. Sun, water, wet, dry, or salt water are hard on any materials.

  • D-Ring for Race Collar Attachment
  • Race Collar compatible
  • Chest and Back Deflector Compatible

The Jettribe SHOCKWAVE Moto riding pants are designed and specially built for the true PWC rider, not just moto-x pants worn in the water. With the PWC rider in mind, our Jettribe R&D team built these riding pants to provide maximum flexibility, comfort, and protection. Jettribe understands that riders in the past wore typical wetsuits for protection while riding, but riding with wetsuits can be cumbersome, restrictive and hard to get in and out of. Most riders still need the protection against the bumps and bruises while riding. With this in mind, Jettribe built the Moto Pants with many features that set our product apart.

The knee and shin areas have EVA compression foam molded pads for that added protection. But our high density EVA foam will not absorb water and stays light. The main material is a tough Sato 420 D. nylon with 2 coats of PU. This material is light and very strong, providing wind and water resistance. Wind and water are really what make you cold. In the inseam panel area, we built an air mesh panel to allow water to pass through and allow you to stay light while keeping in your body heat. The rear panel is constructed out of neoprene to allow maximum flexibility. This panel is also embedded with our Jet Grip - a silicone texture to maximize grip from your "butt" to your runabout's seat. The dual side pockets have a built in drain hole on the outside and the inside is mesh. This allows the water to drain straight through. Once again, we built these pants to be light while wet. Our single pull tight system allows for instant belt release or tightening. Just one pull to tighten or one quick press on the 50 MM buckle to release the waist belt.

The Jettribe Moto Pants are literally used & abused by many of our team riders at the IJSBA World Finals. Yes, these pants are not only tested, but race tested. The Jettribe Moto Pants are not built to replace the wetsuit but they are a great alternative. They provide the PWC rider with comfort and protection against the elements white looking very cool on or out of the water. See you at the next race!!!

Title: UR-20 Side Entry Vest (S/M Only) Multicolor PWC Jetski Ride & Race Jacket
Description:
UR-20 Side Entry Vest Shockwave Multicolor PWC Jetski Ride & Race Jacket

The Jettribe UR-20 Side Entry Vest. This vest is an excellent all-around vest for free riding, freestyle, closed course racing, offshore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well.

As of 2017 the Jettribe UR-20 Side Entry Vest has the incorporated pre-molded foam unique only to our Jettribe race vests. What is it? The pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the contour of the rider’s body, instead of forcing a flat piece EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body.  Plus, our second process is heat and pressure compression, this allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2 inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation.

The UR-20 side entry vests utilize an ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. The ink fusion wraps and dyes the color around the yarn and fibers of the materials. This allows for a smooth, soft, feel to the vest.  And, it will never crack or dry out like the screen printed inks.

We are especially proud of the UR-20.  We have taken the best of all vests and built into this one vest.  Every minute detail has been carefully considered.  For example, all of the webbing are tacked down with a zig-zag bar tack, rescue handles are wrapped underneath, then bar tacked, then finished off with a box stitch. All webbing exit openings are reinforced with a TPR collar for durability.  Most of these details are over-looked by others, but not by the Jettribe design team.

Our Jettribe race vests have been proven with top professional racers throughout the world.  Some of the features that separate our vest from the rest are: triple rescue handles, back protection compatible, triple 38mm buckles and webbing , interchangeable velcro flag patches and removable heavy duty PWC lanyard D-ring. Plus, the rear race collar attachment.

Jettribe designed and developed this vest using the best materials available.  We do recommend that riding equipment be replaced every two seasons. If there are any signs of fading , discoloration or drying out of the materials - please, replace it right away. Sun, water , wet , dry , or salt water are hard on any materials.

The Jettribe wetsuit john and jacket Race Suit is built, designed, and engineered for the riders’ maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility.  Our Jettribe RaceSuits are built with strategic placement of 2-3 mm neoprene panels.  The 3mm panels are for the warmth and 2mm panels are built into the high movement areas: the inner arms and legs. We spent a year field testing with our Jettribe Race Team under racing conditions. The results are features like the Jet Grip texture print placed on the inner thigh panels and legs to provide the rider with additional traction while riding. All seams have our interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin.  We carefully select just the right combination of thicknesses of neoprene to retain a rider’s body heat white riding in various conditions. The wetsuit neoprene’s property is a closed, high density foam made up of thousands of tiny air bubbles known as cells. These cells provide an insulation barrier which slows down the conduction of heat, allowing the body’s heat to be retained.  Jettribe John/Jacket Race Suits are engineered with the understanding of the PWC rider’s constant movement which often over-generates body heat. For example, surf wet suits are designed for a body constantly being in the water.  The bold and oversized graphics are printed by a gas fusing process, so the material is soft and light to the touch without fading or cracking like screenprinted logos.  While our Jettribe Wetsuit John/Jacket Race Suits are designed for the true PWC rider who is both in the water and in the cold air! We at Jettribe are proud to present the Race Suit! Enjoy Every Ride - Jettribe Family!

**NOTE:  2019 GRB 3.0 BOOTS AVAILABLE NOW IN ALL SIZES**

Have you asked for a better riding boot? We at Jettribe have listened. We are proud to release the our GRB 2.0 Race Boots. The GRB 2.0 rubber soles are designed with three raised contact points to accommodate a PWC riders aggressive stance. Most of the time we ride from the ball of our foot, constantly switching our weight from the heel of our feet to our toes. Plus, the pre-curved sole with arch support allows maximum comfort! The sole wraps around the sides and toes, limiting the lateral side to side movement of the riders feet. The extra high neoprene cut of the GRB 2.0 boot limits rocks and gravel from getting in. It has a front 1/2 zippered entry for easy slip on or off. Plus two adjustable velcro straps for a snug and better fit.  We have also added a special rubber piece to the front of the toe area to help grip-in foot holds and provide extra toe protection.

We hope that you will ride with better comfort and performance with our GRB 2.0 Race Boot! Enjoy your next ride!

  • Soles are designed with raised contact points to accommodate a PWC riders aggressive stance.
  • 9 mesh flow through panels allow water to drain quickly. We do not drill a hole on the bottom of soles, like an afterthought.

Title: Tour Coat Shockwave Moto Tour Jacket Multi PWC Jetski Ride & Race
Description:
Tour Coat Shockwave Moto Tour Jacket Multicolor PWC Jetski Ride & Race

The Jettribe Neoprene Tour Coat, or Moto Jacket is designed for those chilly days on or off the Water. The tour coat is made as an additional overlayer to help keep your core temperature high, which is primarily in your chest. From our Jettribe professional team riders, most of the “cold factor” is not from getting wet or falling off your ski, it is from the water splashes and cold, high winds which occur when flying across the water at 80 mph. Our Jettribe Tour Coat has some special features: it has an oversized cut to be worn over the lifevest and wetsuit. Most riders’ major complaints about other tour coats are that jackets are heavy and restrict movement. The Jettribe Tour Coat has pre-curved elbow joints for added comfort, and the 5mm neoprene goes through our proprietary compression process to make it 3.5 mil. This gives the material a lighter feel, while providing the same cold protection density as a 5mm. The bold and oversized graphic is printed by a gas fusing process, so that the material is soft and light to the touch without fading or cracking screenprinted logos.

  • Neoprene with 2 sided lycra for wind and water resistance
  • Neoprene side panels for warmth and flexibility
  • Color: Multicolor

Title: Striker Back Deflector - Yellow/Green PWC Jetski Ride & Race Gear
Description:
Striker Back Deflector Yellow/Green PWC Jetski Ride & Race Gear 

The Jettribe Striker is constructed of a Dual sandwich compression molded EVA foam. The ridged layers provide a semi hard frame but still flexible. The double EVA foam layers adds addition flotation and impact energy absorbing factors absorbing factors.  The Jettribe Striker is design to be worn over the side entry lifevest. The "First Layer" design to is reduce, deflect or defeat the accidental impact at the farthest layer away from the rider’s body.

  • IJSBA and TJSBA compliant
  • Hinged Impact Plates
  • Universal fit for any Jettribe Side-Entry Vest: RS-16, RS-17, Moto1-G2&G3, JetPilot Side-Entry and QuakySense, Yamaha, Kawasaki Fly Side-Entry Vest
  • High Impact Energy Absorbing
  • External ABS Plastic Shell
  • Over under locking velcro for added strength
  • The back deflector is securely attached at six points
  • Meets IJSBA back protection requirements at all sanction races worldwide
  • Only back protection gear designed exclusively for PWC racing
  • Floats independently, which means it will not reduce the flotation of your vest when attached to your race vest

Color:  Yellow/Green with Grey protection plates

Sizing: 23 x 9 1/2 x 1 1/4

Title: UR-20 Side Entry Race Vest Black PWC Jetski Ride & Race Jacket
Description:
UR-20 Side Entry Race Vest Black PWC Jetski Ride & Race Jacket

The Jettribe UR-20 Side Entry Vest. This vest is an excellent all-around vest for free riding, freestyle, closed course racing, offshore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well.

As of 2017 the Jettribe UR-20 Side Entry Vest has the incorporated pre-molded foam unique only to our Jettribe race vests. What is it? The pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the contour of the rider’s body, instead of forcing a flat piece EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body.  Plus, our second process is heat and pressure compression, this allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2 inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation.

The UR-20 side entry vests utilize an ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. The ink fusion wraps and dyes the color around the yarn and fibers of the materials. This allows for a smooth, soft, feel to the vest.  And, it will never crack or dry out like the screen printed inks.

We are especially proud of the UR-20.  We have taken the best of all vests and built into this one vest.  Every minute detail has been carefully considered.  For example, all of the webbing are tacked down with a zig-zag bar tack, rescue handles are wrapped underneath, then bar tacked, then finished off with a box stitch. All webbing exit openings are reinforced with a TPR collar for durability.  Most of these details are over-looked by others, but not by the Jettribe design team.

Our Jettribe race vests have been proven with top professional racers throughout the world.  Some of the features that separate our vest from the rest are: triple rescue handles, back protection compatible, triple 38mm buckles and webbing , interchangeable velcro flag patches and removable heavy duty PWC lanyard D-ring. Plus, the rear race collar attachment.

Jettribe designed and developed this vest using the best materials available.  We do recommend that riding equipment be replaced every two seasons. If there are any signs of fading , discoloration or drying out of the materials - please, replace it right away. Sun, water, wet, dry, or salt water are hard on any materials.

  • Three-Buckles Closure
  • Adjustable Straps
  • Removable Velcro Patch
  • Jettribe Lanyard loop attachment
  • D-Ring for Race Collar Attachment
  • Race Collar compatible
  • Chest and Back Deflector Compatible
  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility and comfort

The Jettribe wetsuit john and jacket Race Suit is built, designed, and engineered for the riders’ maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility.  Our Jettribe RaceSuits are built with strategic placement of 2-3 mm neoprene panels.  The 3mm panels are for the warmth and 2mm panels are built into the high movement areas: the inner arms and legs. We spent a year field testing with our Jettribe Race Team under racing conditions. The results are features like the Jet Grip texture print placed on the inner thigh panels and legs to provide the rider with additional traction while riding. All seams have our interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin.  We carefully select just the right combination of thicknesses of neoprene to retain a rider’s body heat white riding in various conditions. The wetsuit neoprene’s property is a closed, high density foam made up of thousands of tiny air bubbles known as cells. These cells provide an insulation barrier which slows down the conduction of heat, allowing the body’s heat to be retained.  Jettribe John/Jacket Race Suits are engineered with the understanding of the PWC rider’s constant movement which often over-generates body heat. For example, surf wet suits are designed for a body constantly being in the water.  The bold and oversized graphics are printed by a gas fusing process, so the material is soft and light to the touch without fading or cracking like screenprinted logos.  While our Jettribe Wetsuit John/Jacket Race Suits are designed for the true PWC rider who is both in the water and in the cold air! We at Jettribe are proud to present the Race Suit! Enjoy Every Ride - Jettribe Family!

Description:
U.S.C.G. Shattered Side-Entry Vest - Grey 

The Jettribe USCG (US Coast Guard Approved) Side Entry Vest is IJSBA race legal all over the world. This vest is an excellent all-around vest for riding freestyle, closed-course racing, off-shore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well. 

Product Safety Features:

  • US Coast Guard Type 3
  • IJSBA Race Legal
  • Strength tested at 100 MPH
  • Three-Buckle Closure
  • Triple 38mm buckles and webbing
  • Reinforced Shoulder Rescue Handles
  • Removable Velcro Patch
  • Removable Jettribe Lanyard Loop Attachment Included
  • Back Deflector compatible
  • Made of Nylon & EVA Foam

The Jettribe USCG (U.S. Coast Guard) Approved Side-Entry Vest has the incorporated rescue handles unique only to our Jettribe race vests.  The rescue handles are wrapped underneath and bar tacked, then finished off with a box stitch. Some of the features that separate our vest from the rest are: triple rescue handles, back protection compatible, triple 38mm buckles and webbing, inter-changeable velcro flag patches, and removable heavy duty PWC lanyard D-ring.  Plus, the rear race collar attachment. 

Jettribe designed and developed the vests using the best materials available. We do recommend that riding equipment be replaced every two seasons.  If there are any signs of fading, discoloration, or drying out of the materials - please, replace it right away.  Sun, water, wet, dry, or salt water are hard on any materials. 

 

 

 
 
Regarding Sizes: There is no current USCG certification available for this style Side-Entry Vest in sizes XS and 2XL.

Title: Tour Coat Scratch Moto Tour Grey (Clearance) - Small
Description:
Tour Coat Scratch Moto Tour Grey - Clearance

The Jettribe Neoprene Tour Coat, or Moto Jacket is designed for those chilly days on or off the Water. The tour coat is made as an additional overlayer to help keep your core temperature high, which is primarily in your chest. From our Jettribe professional team riders, most of the “cold factor” is not from getting wet or falling off your ski, it is from the water splashes and cold, high winds which occur when flying across the water at 80 mph. Our Jettribe Tour Coat has some special features: it has an oversized cut to be worn over the lifevest and wetsuit. Most riders’ major complaints about other tour coats are that jackets are heavy and restrict movement. Title: Striker Back Deflector SMALL | Spinal Protection | Grey / White | 20 Inch
Description:
Striker Back Deflector Grey/ White

The 20.5 inch size will fit most youth and adult riders. See size chart below.

The Jettribe Striker is constructed of a Dual sandwich compression molded EVA foam. The ridged layers provide a semi hard frame but still flexible. The double EVA foam layers adds addition flotation and impact energy absorbing factors absorbing factors.  The Jettribe Striker is design to be worn over the side entry lifevest. The "First Layer" design to is reduce, deflect or defeat the accidental impact at the farthest layer away from the rider’s body.

  • IJSBA and TJSBA compliant
  • Hinged Impact Plates
  • Universal fit for most any Side-Entry Vest
  • High Impact Energy Absorbing
  • External ABS Plastic Shell
  • Over under locking velcro for added strength
  • The back deflector is securely attached at six points
  • Meets IJSBA back protection requirements at all sanction races worldwide
  • Only back protection gear designed exclusively for PWC racing
  • Floats independently, which means it will not reduce the flotation of your vest when attached to your race vest

Large Sizing: 23 x 9.5 x 1.25 inches

Small Sizing: 20.5 x 9.5 x 1.25 inches

Title: Yamaha V1 Series (2015-2017) Cover PWC Jetski Ride & Race
Description:
Jettribe PWC Cover for Yamaha Models:

  • Yamaha V1 Series (2015-2017)

Thank you for checking out one of the best PWC covers on the market today. Our Jettribe premium cover offers the most water resistant, water repellent and weather protection for your watercraft, plus our covers are specially built for trailering. Here are some cool features that set our PWC covers above the rest.  We added four 1.5" webbing detachable tie downs, plus we ran shock cord bungee all around the bottom leading edge. For weather resistance, our materials are specially UV coated with the exclusive (CFM) material that is formulated only for Jettribe! It took us nearly two years to figure out the formula! For water resistance, the material is coated with three clear layers of PU backing to keep out water. All our seams are triple stitched and finished off with a binding. No exposed seams! The inside hood area is lined with soft nytex material to protect your PWC's from getting scratched paint. All pin or eye bow areas are reinforced with a tough extra layer of Nylon material. When fueling up, most of our covers have a gas flap opening.  Talk is talk, but seeing is believing! Check out our Jettribe covers online or at your local dealer. They are truly a perfect quality, fit, finish, and a true work of art!

Description:
Jettribe Dry Suit - Green

*Note: Dry Suits are not eligible for additional discounts and promotions

What is a Dry Suit? The Jettribe Dry Suit is a designed for use in cold climates (35°F - 55°F degrees).  Unlike a traditional PWC wetsuit that allows water to flow through the suit, a Dry Suit has welded seams to help keep the rider dry and warm on the inside of the suit. It is also designed to move and flex with the movements of a watercraft rider, while providing protection from cold wind and water.

  • Recommended for 35°F - 55°F
  • Comprised of 5mm Closed Cell neoprene to create a water and windproof suit
  • Direct injection silicone knee pad
  • 2 piece leg and wrist cuff system, with water tight inner seal and external adjustable velcro fit
  • Every seam is RF welded for added wind and water protection
  • The top portion of the suit is made of 420 Nylon for flexibility
  • TPR rubber logo on chest that is both sewed and welded to the suit
  • Rear entry using heavy duty #10 marine grade zipper

We do recommend that riding equipment be replaced every two seasons.  If there are any signs of fading, discoloration, or drying out of the materials - please, replace it right away.  Sun, water, wet, dry, or salt water are hard on any materials. 

The vest is speed rated and race legal by sanctioned race organizations IJSBA & TJSBA.

  • IJSBA Race Legal
  • Strength tested at 100 MPH
  • Side-Entry buckle closure
  • Triple 38mm buckles and webbing
  • Reinforced Triple Rescue Handles
  • Removable heavy duty PWC lanyard D-ring

Description:
UR-20 Spike Comp Vest - Grey

Discontinued Style - No additional stock will be produced

The Jettribe UR-20 Side Entry Vest is an excellent all-around vest for free riding, freestyle, closed course racing, offshore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well.

The Jettribe UR-20 Side Entry Vest has incorporated a pre-molded foam unique only to our Jettribe race vests. Instead of forcing a flat piece EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s chest and back.  

The UR-20 side entry vests utilize an ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. The ink fusion wraps and dyes the color around the yarn and fibers of the materials. This allows for a smooth, soft, feel to the vest.  It will never crack or dry out like the screen printed inks. Plus, our second foam process is heat and pressure compression, this allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2 inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation.

Product Features

  • Three-Buckles Closure
  • Adjustable Straps
  • Removable Velcro Patch
  • Jettribe Lanyard attachment
  • D-Ring for Race Collar Attachment
  • Back Deflector Compatible
  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility and comfort
  • Competition Level Vest (closed course racing, private recreation). No USCG Certification. 
  • SGS Buoyancy Aid Tested (scan QR code to view report)

Title: UR-20 Spike Vest - White /Black PWC Jetski Ride & Race Gear
Description:
UR-20 Spike Vest - White w/ Black Spikes

The Jettribe UR-20 Side Entry Vest is an excellent all-around vest for free riding, freestyle, closed course racing, offshore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well.

The Jettribe UR-20 Side Entry Vest has incorporated a pre-molded foam unique only to our Jettribe race vests. What is it? The pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s body, instead of forcing a flat piece EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body.  Plus, our second process is heat and pressure compression, this allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2 inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation.

The UR-20 side entry vests utilize an ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. The ink fusion wraps and dyes the color around the yarn and fibers of the materials. This allows for a smooth, soft, feel to the vest.  It will never crack or dry out like the screen printed inks.

We are especially proud of the UR-20.  We have taken the best of all vests and built into this one vest.  Every detail has been carefully considered.  For example, all of the webbings are tacked down with a zig-zag bar tack, rescue handles are wrapped underneath, then bar tacked, then finished off with a box stitch. All webbing exit openings are reinforced with a TPR collar for durability.  Most of these details are over-looked by others, but not by the Jettribe design team.

Jettribe designed and developed this vest using the best materials available.  We do recommend that riding equipment be replaced every two seasons. If there are any signs of fading, discoloration or drying out of the materials - please, replace it right away. Sun, water, wet, dry, or salt water are hard on any materials.

Rashguard Shattered - Blue

  • UV Protection
  • Sublimate Graphics (Soft to Touch, no skin irritation like silkscreen)
  • 4-Way Stretch poly lycra
  • Breathable and quick-drying
  • 20% Spandex and 80% polyester fabric
  • Lightweight, stretchy, and easy movement for riding PWC and other water activities
  • Comfort fit and design offers ultimate warmth and sunburn prevention for hours of PWC riding

Flatlock stitching is an ideal stitching style for watercraft riding gear. The parallel stitching method is perfect for riding gear due to its strength and flexibility. Open to water penetration, the unique seam offers high performance and fast drying times, that complement the rashguard’s light, breathable fabric. Count on flat-lock stitching to keep your long or short sleeved guard wearing great every day. The tight fit provides optimal staying power on even the roughest waters.

The Jettribe rashguard’s fade-resistant coloring and design is made the enhance your time on the water. Make the most out of your next ride with this high performance and comfortable rashguard.

The Jettribe Kids Neoprene Tour Coat, or Moto Jacket, is designed exactly like our adult jackets, to warm junior riders on those chilly days on or off the water.

  • Designed for those chilly days on or off the water.
  • Made as additional overlayer to help keep your core temperature high, primarily in your chest area
  • Protects from water splashes while on your ski and the cold, high winds when flying across the water at fast speeds

  • Pre-Curved elbow joins for added comfort and flexibility
  • Proprietary compression process makes 5mm neoprene until 3.5mm for a lighter feel and better cold protection
  • Bold and oversized graphics are printed by gas fusion process, so material is soft and light to the touch, without cracking or fading

Title: UR-20 Spike Vest - Red | Size XS Only | Closeout
Description:
UR-20 Spike Vest - Red

The Jettribe UR-20 Side Entry Vest is an excellent all-around vest for free riding, freestyle, closed course racing, offshore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well.

The Jettribe UR-20 Side Entry Vest has incorporated a pre-molded foam unique only to our Jettribe race vests. What is it? The pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s body, instead of forcing a flat piece EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body.  Plus, our second process is heat and pressure compression, this allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2 inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation.

The UR-20 side entry vests utilize an ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. The ink fusion wraps and dyes the color around the yarn and fibers of the materials. This allows for a smooth, soft, feel to the vest.  It will never crack or dry out like the screen printed inks.

We are especially proud of the UR-20.  We have taken the best of all vests and built into this one vest.  Every detail has been carefully considered.  For example, all of the webbings are tacked down with a zig-zag bar tack, rescue handles are wrapped underneath, then bar tacked, then finished off with a box stitch. All webbing exit openings are reinforced with a TPR collar for durability.  Most of these details are over-looked by others, but not by the Jettribe design team.

  • Three-Buckles Closure
  • Adjustable Straps
  • Removable Velcro Patch
  • Jettribe Lanyard attachment
  • D-Ring for Race Collar Attachment
  • Race Collar compatible
  • Chest and Back Deflector Compatible
  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility and comfort

Jettribe designed and developed this vest using the best materials available.  We do recommend that riding equipment be replaced every two seasons. If there are any signs of fading, discoloration or drying out of the materials - please, replace it right away. Sun, water, wet, dry, or salt water are hard on any materials.

Title: UR-20 Spike Vest - Orange PWC Jetski Ride & Race Gear
Description:
UR-20 Spike Vest - Orange

The Jettribe UR-20 Side Entry Vest is an excellent all-around vest for free riding, freestyle, closed course racing, offshore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well.

The Jettribe UR-20 Side Entry Vest has incorporated a pre-molded foam unique only to our Jettribe race vests. What is it? The pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s body, instead of forcing a flat piece EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body.  Plus, our second process is heat and pressure compression, this allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2 inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation.

The UR-20 side entry vests utilize an ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. The ink fusion wraps and dyes the color around the yarn and fibers of the materials. This allows for a smooth, soft, feel to the vest.  It will never crack or dry out like the screen printed inks.

We are especially proud of the UR-20.  We have taken the best of all vests and built into this one vest.  Every detail has been carefully considered.  For example, all of the webbings are tacked down with a zig-zag bar tack, rescue handles are wrapped underneath, then bar tacked, then finished off with a box stitch. All webbing exit openings are reinforced with a TPR collar for durability.  Most of these details are over-looked by others, but not by the Jettribe design team.

  • Three-Buckles Closure
  • Adjustable Straps
  • Removable Velcro Patch
  • Jettribe Lanyard attachment
  • D-Ring for Race Collar Attachment
  • Race Collar compatible
  • Chest and Back Deflector Compatible
  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility and comfort

Jettribe designed and developed this vest using the best materials available.  We do recommend that riding equipment be replaced every two seasons. If there are any signs of fading, discoloration or drying out of the materials - please, replace it right away. Sun, water, wet, dry, or salt water are hard on any materials.

When fueling up, most of our covers have a gas flap opening.  Talk is talk, but seeing is believing! Check out our Jettribe covers online or at your local dealer. They are truly a perfect quality, fit, finish, and a true work of art!

Description:
UR-20 Spike Vest - Neon Orange

Discontinued Style - No additional stock or sizes will be produced

The Jettribe UR-20 Side Entry Vest is an excellent all-around vest for free riding, freestyle, closed course racing, offshore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well.

The Jettribe UR-20 Side Entry Vest has incorporated a pre-molded foam unique only to our Jettribe race vests. What is it? The pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s body, instead of forcing a flat piece EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body.  Plus, our second process is heat and pressure compression, this allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2 inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation.

The UR-20 side entry vests utilize an ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. The ink fusion wraps and dyes the color around the yarn and fibers of the materials. This allows for a smooth, soft, feel to the vest.  It will never crack or dry out like the screen printed inks.

We are especially proud of the UR-20.  We have taken the best of all vests and built into this one vest.  Every detail has been carefully considered.  For example, all of the webbings are tacked down with a zig-zag bar tack, rescue handles are wrapped underneath, then bar tacked, then finished off with a box stitch. All webbing exit openings are reinforced with a TPR collar for durability.  Most of these details are over-looked by others, but not by the Jettribe design team.

  • Three-Buckles Closure

  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility and comfort

Jettribe designed and developed this vest using the best materials available.  We do recommend that riding equipment be replaced every two seasons. Title: UR-20P Newport Vest | Pink | Comfort EVA Foam | Closeout Size 2XL Only
Description:
UR-20P Newport Vest - Pink

Style Discontinued - No additional sizes will be produced

The main feature of a UR-20 Series Vest is the incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest.  Instead of forcing a flat piece EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flotation and flexibility to conform to the rider’s chest and back. The Jettribe UR-20P Side Entry Vest is an excellent all-around vest for free riding, freestyle, closed course racing, offshore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well.

Product Features

The UR-20P side entry vest utilizes ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. The ink fusion wraps and dyes the color around the yarn and fibers of the materials. This allows for a smooth, soft, feel to the vest.  It will never crack or dry out like the screen printed inks.  Plus, our foam second process is heat and pressure compression, which allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2-inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation.

  • Three-Buckles Closure
  • Adjustable Straps
  • Jettribe Lanyard attachment
  • D-Ring for Race Collar Attachment
  • Back Deflector Compatible
  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility, flotation, and comfort
  • Note: Vest sizing is unisex and is the same style as all other UR-20 vests

Custom Name Plate Option

The incorporated back name plate gives you the option of ordering customized vinyl lettering (sold separately) that are heat-transferred directly on your removable plate.  Show off your Name and Race Number from your local training spot, all the way to the Lake Havasu World Finals.  Available in Standard and Moto Fonts. [Note: Customization takes an additional 1-3 weeks to produce]

Title: UR-20P Newport Vest | Purple | Comfort EVA Foam | Closeout - Size XXL only
Description:
Ladies UR-20P Newport Vest - Purple

The main feature of a UR-20 Series Vest is the incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest.  Instead of forcing a flat piece EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility and flotation to conform to the rider’s chest and back. The Jettribe UR-20P Side Entry Vest is an excellent all-around vest for free riding, freestyle, closed course racing, offshore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well.

Product Features

The UR-20P side entry vest utilizes ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. The ink fusion wraps and dyes the color around the yarn and fibers of the materials. This allows for a smooth, soft, feel to the vest.  It will never crack or dry out like the screen printed inks.  Plus, our foam second process is heat and pressure compression, which allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2-inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation.

  • Three-Buckles Closure
  • Adjustable Straps
  • Jettribe Lanyard attachment
  • D-Ring for Race Collar Attachment
  • Back Deflector Compatible
  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility, flotation, and comfort
  • Note: Vest sizing is unisex and is the same style as all other UR-20 vests

Custom Name Plate Option

The incorporated back name plate gives you the option of ordering customized vinyl lettering (sold separately) that are heat-transferred directly on your removable plate.  Show off your Name and Race Number from your local training spot, all the way to the Lake Havasu World Finals.  Available in Standard and Moto Fonts. [Note: Customization takes an additional 1-3 weeks to produce]

Title: Dry Suit - Black PWC Jet Ski Ride & Race Freestyle
Description:
Jettribe Dry Suit - Black

*Note: Dry Suits are not eligible for additional discounts and promotions

What is a Dry Suit? The Jettribe Dry Suit is a designed for use in cold climates (35°F - 55°F degrees).  Unlike a traditional PWC wetsuit that allows water to flow through the suit, a Dry Suit has welded seams to help keep the rider dry and warm on the inside of the suit. It is also designed to move and flex with the movements of a watercraft rider, while providing protection from cold wind and water.

  • Comprised of 5mm Closed Cell neoprene to create a water and windproof suit
  • Recommended for 35°F - 55°F
  • Direct injection silicone knee pad
  • 2 piece leg and wrist cuff system, with water tight inner seal and external adjustable velcro fit
  • Every seam is RF welded for added wind and water protection
  • The top portion of the suit is made of 420 Nylon for flexibility
  • TPR rubber logo on chest that is both sewed and welded to the suit
  • Rear entry using heavy duty #10 marine grade zipper

Title: Lycra Socks Gator Top - Size XS (Boot Size 5 - 6)
Description:
Lycra Gator Top PWC Socks

With Exclusive Dual-Layer Design, the Second Layer is designed to fold Over Your Boots to Keep Sand, Rocks, and Gravel Out of Your Boots.

  • Made of Water-Wicking Lycra
  • A Perfect Match for all Jettribe Race Boots
  • Boots Sizes:

Size 5, 6 = XS/S
Size 7, 8, 9 = M/L
Size 10, 11, 12, 13 = XL/ XXL

  • Color: Black

 

2016 Review from The Watercraft Journal

"Much more than the traditional neoprene sock – wields several key attributes that elevate them above and beyond the aforementioned neoprene: first, with them on the Jettribe boots are immediately some of the most comfortable boots we’ve ever worn; next, the neoprene boots are cut extra high and feature a fold-down dual-layer to keep out rocks and gravel; and lastly, they’re not made from neoprene but “airprene” – an advanced form of neoprene (U.S. Patent #4832010) that is a unique perforated fabric that “removes perspiration – letting the skin ‘breathe’ – during strenuous exercise.” As moisture leaves, body heat stays in, “keeping muscles, tendons, and ligaments loose and supple,” as Jettribe describes."

  • Unisex – for both men & women

Shoe is based on US Men’s Sizing

The Jettribe rashguard’s fade-resistant coloring and design is made the enhance your time on the water. Make the most out of your next ride with this high performance and comfortable rashguard.

Title: UR-20 24k Gold / Black Life Vest | Size XS Only | Closeout | Showpiece Vest
Description:
UR-2O Competition Vest - 24k Series - Showpiece Type Vest

Note: Due to the bright shiny Gold panels on this vest, it works best as a "showpiece" vest reserved for race events. Please be aware with moderate to heavy use the shinny gold can rub off. Due to this feature, the price of the vest has been reduced. Returns or exchanges will not accepted for worn vests.

Jettribe UR-20 24k Series Vests are an excellent all-around vest for free riding, freestyle, closed course racing, offshore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well (in areas that allow competition / non-USCG certified vests).

The Jettribe UR-20 Side Entry Vest has incorporated a pre-molded foam unique only to our Jettribe race vests. What is it? The pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s body, instead of forcing a flat piece EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body.  Plus, our second process is heat and pressure compression, this allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2 inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation.

  • Three-Buckles Closure
  • Adjustable Side Straps
  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility and comfort
  • Triple Rescue Handles, located on both shoulders and back
  • Jettribe Lanyard Loop attachment
  • Back Deflector Compatible 
  • Note: This vest does not have USCG Certification

We are especially proud of the UR-20.  We have taken the best of all vests and built into this one vest.  Every detail has been carefully considered.  For example, all of the webbings are tacked down with a zig-zag bar tack, rescue handles are wrapped underneath, then bar tacked, then finished off with a box stitch. All webbing exit openings are reinforced with a TPR collar for durability.  Most of these details are over-looked by others, but not by the Jettribe design team.

Flatlock stitching is an ideal stitching style for watercraft riding gear. The parallel stitching method is perfect for riding gear due to its strength and flexibility. Open to water penetration, the unique seam offers high performance and fast drying times, that complement the rashguard’s light, breathable fabric. Count on flat-lock stitching to keep your long sleeved guard wearing great every day. The tight fit provides optimal staying power on even the roughest waters.

The Jettribe rashguard’s fade-resistant coloring and design is made the enhance your time on the water. Make the most out of your next ride with this high performance and comfortable rashguard.

Description:
UR-20 Vest - Hot Water The Movie Official Merchandise

Jettribe is proud to be the official gear partner for the movie Hot Water, Directed by Larry Rippenkroeger

The main feature of a UR-20 Series Vest is the incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest.  Instead of forcing a flat piece EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s chest and back. The Jettribe UR-20P Side Entry Vest is an excellent all-around vest for free riding, freestyle, closed course racing, offshore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well.

Product Features

The UR-20P side entry vest utilizes ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. The ink fusion wraps and dyes the color around the yarn and fibers of the materials. This allows for a smooth, soft, feel to the vest.  It will never crack or dry out like the screen printed inks.  Plus, our foam second process is heat and pressure compression, which allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2-inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation. The 3 rescue handles help others pull a downed rider back up on their ski.

  • Three-Buckles Closure
  • 3 Rescue Handles
  • Adjustable Side Entry Straps

Team Rider Wetsuit Jacket - Black / Grey

Limited Edition Series

Team Rider Wetsuits are sold as separate John & Jackets for the first time! Designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility.  "S-Tek" neoprene added for improved stretch and durability.  Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider. The new front angled zipper design is easier to pull up and down with less stress on the suit.

Hybrid Jacket Top Features Include: 

  • Hybrid Jacket with built-in hood for keeping warm between rides
  • New Ergonomic Angled Marine Grade Zipper (designed at an angle, not straight up and down)
  • Jacket can be worn with a sleeveless wetsuit john, shorts, or swimwear to stay warm
  • Dual Purpose cut, not as restricting as a traditional wetsuit top (vest is worn over the jacket)
  • Not an oversized cut like a tour coat
  • 3mm neoprene in chest and back (works best for temps down to 50-55F degrees)
  • "S-Tek" neoprene for improved stretch and durability
  • 2.5mm side movement panels for a PWC riders needed flexibility
  • All seams have our interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin

If you are on the high end of one size's measurements, we always encourage you to order the next larger size. Title: USCG Black Out Vest | Custom Options | Coast Guard Approved Type 3
Description:
USCG Black Out Vest

COLOR: BLACK VEST / GREY PLATE

The new Jettribe USCG-P (US Coast Guard Approved) Black Out Side-Entry Vest is race legal all over the world. This vest is an excellent all-around vest for riding freestyle, closed-course racing, off-shore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well.

The vest is strength tested up to 100 MPH and race legal by sanctioned race organizations like the IJSBA.

Product Features Include:

  • Dual rescue handles
  • USCG (US Coast Guard) Certification
  • Triple 38mm buckles and webbing
  • Upgraded Black heavy-duty PWC lanyard attachment D-ring
  • Back Deflector compatible
  • Removable TPR Rubber Jettribe Logo on front and back (different color logos can be purchased in Color Kits sold separately)
  • Includes a Light Grey Name Plate (Custom Color Kits sold separately)
  • Made of Nylon & EVA Foam (not neoprene)
Color Kit Option ($34.99 each):

The vest can be customized with a Black Out Color Kit. The kit includes a new name plate, front and back TPR Rubber logos, and lanyard loop in one of 6 colors. Customize the look of your vest to match your ski or your personal style. Each Kit is sold as a set. Custom name/number printing is an additional charge ($40).

Check out this video review of the Color Kit from JD's Water World on Youtube

Customized Name Plate Print Option ($40 Option):

The vest includes a grey incorporated name plate. We offer the option of ordering customized white vinyl lettering (sold separately) that are heat-transferred directly on the back name plate. Show off your Name and Race Number from your local training spot, all the way to the Lake Havasu World Finals. Available in Standard and Moto Fonts. [Note: Customization takes an additional 1-2 weeks and the custom plate is shipped separately from the vest] (Please note: We cannot print profane or offensive customization)

This is not a spine back protection plate, it is a removable piece for customization purposes only. Race Back Protection can be purchased separately.

Description:
UR-20P Team Rider Vest- Blue/Grey

The main feature of a UR-20 Series Vest is the incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest. Instead of forcing a flat piece of EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s chest and back.

Product Features Include:

The UR-20 Side-Entry Vest utilizes ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. Plus, our foam second process is heat and pressure compression, which allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2-inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation. This is a competition level vest for closed course racing or private recreation. USCG Certification is not included.

  • Three-Buckle Closure
  • Adjustable Side Straps
  • Shoulder Velcro Patch
  • Removable "Lanyard Loop" Attachment
  • Dual Rescue Handles, to help pull a downed rider back up on their ski
  • D-Ring for Race Collar Attachment
  • Back Deflector Compatible
  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility and comfort
  • Vest sizing is unisex for men, women, and youth

Hyper John & Jacket Wetsuit 2 Piece Set - Blue / Red

The Jettribe Wetsuit John & Jacket Race Suit is built, designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility. "S.Tec" neoprene added for improved stretch and durability. Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider.

2 Piece Set - Includes sleeveless john and a long sleeve jacket

  • Jettribe wetsuits have built in movement panels to help a PWC rider flex side-to-side

Product Features
  • Abrasion resistant wire mesh neoprene in the seat and knees
  • Left shoulder velcro entry
  • Ankle zippers for easy on and off
  • 2nd Generation "S.Tec" neoprene for improved stretch and durability. Soft and comfortable.

  • Marine-grade zipper on the jacket top

 

    

Sizing Information: Please take special care to determine the best size for your wetsuit purchase. Use your largest measurement to choose your wetsuit size. For example, if your Height and Weight are Size Large, but your Chest and Waist are a Size X-Large, then X-Large is your best wetsuit size. If you are on the high end of one size's measurements, we always encourage you to order the next larger size. The wetsuit is designed to be a tight fit. Please feel free to email, call, or contact us on Live Chat to ask your sizing questions.


Chest and Waist Measurements are the best way to determine your wetsuit size.

Return/Exchange Policy: If the size you receive still does not work for your body type/frame, returns and exchanges may be requested within 30 days of delivery for new, unused wetsuits returned in original condition and original packaging. Wetsuits must follow our wetsuit folding policy to ensure the wetsuit is not creased or damaged in shipping. Link: Wetsuit Return Instructions Returns are subject to inspection upon arrival. Wetsuits that have been used, washed, dirty, stained, or are damaged due to pet hair, smoke exposure, or creased are not eligible for a refund/exchange.

Title: UR-20 Life Vest Hot Water Movie | Comfort Flex Foam | (Photography Sample)
Description:
UR-20 Vest - Hot Water The Movie Official Merchandise

Photography Samples Available - Limited Quantities While Supplies Last

Jettribe is proud to be the official gear partner for the movie Hot Water, Directed by Larry Rippenkroeger

The main feature of a UR-20 Series Vest is the incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest.  Instead of forcing a flat piece EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s chest and back. The Jettribe UR-20P Side Entry Vest is an excellent all-around vest for free riding, freestyle, closed course racing, offshore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well.

Product Features

The UR-20P side entry vest utilizes ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. The ink fusion wraps and dyes the color around the yarn and fibers of the materials. This allows for a smooth, soft, feel to the vest.  It will never crack or dry out like the screen printed inks.  Plus, our foam second process is heat and pressure compression, which allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2-inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation. The 3 rescue handles help others pull a downed rider back up on their ski.

  • Three-Buckles Closure
  • 3 Rescue Handles
  • Adjustable Side Entry Straps
  • Upgraded Black Jettribe Lanyard Loop attachment included ($9.99 Value)
  • D-Ring for Race Collar Attachment

This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation. This is a competition level vest for closed course racing or private recreation. USCG Certification is not included.

Title: Premium Trailer Traction Grip Tape | 2 Piece Set
Description:
Jettribe Premium Trailer Traction Tape

  • Set includes 2 traction tape decals with the Jettribe logo
  • Traction tape is designed for use with steel trailer fenders
  • Peel and stick
  • Helps keep your grip when surfaces are wet or slippery
  • Works with dual, tandem axle trailers
  • Great for both watercraft and boat trailers
  • Large Size: 34 inches x 6 inches (86 x 15 cm)

Installation Instructions

  1. Clean the trailer surface well. Optional - Apply Jettribe "Decal On" Spray to the fender surface (Sold Separately)
  2. Peel off the decal backing and position over the center of the fender
  3. Carefully place the decal down and gently brush with a flat smooth object like a Jettribe Squeegee or credit card to remove air pockets
  4. Allow at least 30 minutes for decal to adhere and dry before driving or submerging in water

Sizing Information: Please take special care to determine the best size for your wetsuit jacket purchase. Use your largest measurement to choose your size. For example, if your Height and Weight are Size Large, but your Chest and Waist are a Size X-Large, then X-Large is your best size. If you are on the high end of one size's measurements, we always encourage you to order the next larger size. The wetsuit jacket is designed to be a tight fit.
