Team Rider Wetsuit Set - Red

Team Rider Wetsuits designed and engineered for the riders’ maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth, and mobility. “S-Tec” neoprene added for improved stretch and durability. Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a watercraft rider.

Hybrid Jacket Top Features:
  • Hybrid Jacket with built-in hood for keeping warm between rides
  • New Ergonomic Angled Marine Grade Zipper (designed at an angle, not straight up and down)
  • Jacket can be worn with a sleeveless wetsuit john, shorts, or swimwear to stay warm
  • Dual Purpose cut, not as restricting as a traditional wetsuit top (vest is worn over the jacket)
  • 3mm neoprene in chest and back (works best for temps down to 50-55F degrees)
  • "S-Tec" neoprene for improved stretch and durability
  • 2.5mm side movement panels for a PWC riders needed flexibility
Sleeveless Wetsuit John Features:
  • Abrasion resistant wire mesh neoprene in the seat and knees to prevent wear & tear
  • 2.5mm neoprene (works best for temps down to 50-55F degrees)
  • “S-Tec” neoprene for improved stretch and durability
  • 2.5mm side movement panels for a PWC riders needed flexibility
  • Left shoulder velcro entry
  • Ankle zippers for easy on and off
  • All seams have an interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin
  • Carefully selected neoprene for the right combination of thickness to retain a rider’s body heat in various conditions
  • PWC Manufacturers recommend wetsuits to help protect your skin and body from injury in the event of a fall

Sizing Information: Please take special care to determine the best size for your wetsuit purchase. Use your largest measurement to choose your wetsuit size. For example, if your Height and Weight are Size Large, but your Chest and Waist are a Size X-Large, then X-Large is your best wetsuit size. If you are on the high end of one size's measurements, we always encourage you to order the next larger size. The wetsuit is designed to be a tight fit. Please feel free to email, call, or contact us on Live Chat to ask your sizing questions.

Return/Exchange Policy: If the size you receive still does not work for your body type/frame, returns and exchanges may be requested within 30 days of delivery for new, unused wetsuits returned in original condition and original packaging.  Wetsuits must follow our wetsuit folding policy to ensure the wetsuit is not creased or damaged in shipping. Link: Wetsuit Return Instructions Returns are subject to inspection upon arrival. Wetsuits that have been used, washed, dirty, stained, or are damaged due to pet hair, smoke exposure, or creased are not eligible for a refund/exchange.

The Jettribe Wetsuit John & Jacket Race Suit is built, designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility.  Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider.

  • Set includes both the wetsuit sleeveless john, and the longsleeve jacket

  • Carefully selected neoprene for the right combination of thickness to retain a rider's body heat in various conditions

If you are on the high end of one size's measurements, we always encourage you to order the next larger size. The wetsuit is designed to be a tight fit. Please feel free to email, call, or contact us on Live Chat to ask your sizing questions.

Chest and Waist Measurements are the best way to determine your wetsuit size.

 

Return/Exchange Policy: If the size you receive still does not work for your body type/frame, returns and exchanges may be requested within 30 days of delivery for new, unused wetsuits returned in original condition and original packaging.  Wetsuits must follow our wetsuit folding policy to ensure the wetsuit is not creased or damaged in shipping. Link: Wetsuit Return Instructions Returns are subject to inspection upon arrival. Wetsuits that have been used, washed, dirty, stained, or are damaged due to pet hair, smoke exposure, or creased are not eligible for a refund/exchange.

Description:
Sample - Pivot John & Jacket Wetsuit Set | Grey / Black

Closeout Notice: This is a product sample. See photos for example.  This is a closeout product that is sold "as-is" with no warranty or free returns.

The Jettribe Wetsuit John & Jacket Race Suit is built, designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility.  Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider.

  • Set includes both the wetsuit sleeveless john, and the longsleeve hooded jacket
  • Built with 3mm panels are for warmth and 2mm panels for high movement areas like the inner arms and legs
  • 2nd Generation "S-Tek" neoprene built for the PWC riders stance
  • Side pocket on the leg
  • PWC Manufacturers recommend wetsuits to help protect your skin and body from injury in the event of a fall

Silicone Knee Panels

  • Silicone knee print to help prevent wear and tear damage on the knees and lower leg
  • Vivid and Bright Screenprinted Graphics
  • All seams have our interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin
  • Carefully selected neoprene for the right combination of thickness to retain a rider's body heat in various conditions
  • Neoprene is a closed, high density foam made up of thousands of tiny air bubbles (cells) which provide an insulation barrier to slow down the conduction of heat
  • John/Jacket Race Suits are engineered with the understanding that constant rider movement over-generates body heat while in water and open air, as opposed to surf wetsuits that are designed to always be in water

For example, if your Height and Weight are Size Large, but your Chest and Waist are a Size X-Large, then X-Large is your best wetsuit size. If you are on the high end of one size's measurements, we always encourage you to order the next larger size. The wetsuit is designed to be a tight fit. Please feel free to email, call, or contact us on Live Chat to ask your sizing questions.

The Jettribe Wetsuit John & Jacket Race Suit is built, designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility. Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider.

  • Set includes both the wetsuit sleeveless john, and the longsleeve jacket
  • Built with 3mm panels are for warmth and 2mm panels for high movement areas like the inner arms and legs
  • First Generation "S-Tek" neoprene for improved stretch, built for the PWC riders stance
  • PWC Manufacturers recommend wetsuits to help protect your skin and body from injury in the event of a fall

"S-Tek" Neoprene & Abrasion Resistant Knee Panels

  • Vivid and Bright Screenprinted Graphics
  • All seams have our interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin
  • Carefully selected neoprene for the right combination of thickness to retain a rider's body heat in various conditions
  • Neoprene is a closed, high density foam made up of thousands of tiny air bubbles (cells) which provide an insulation barrier to slow down the conduction of heat
  • John/Jacket Race Suits are engineered with the understanding that constant rider movement over-generates body heat while in water and open air, as opposed to surf wetsuits that are designed to always be in water

Title: UR-20 Pivot Vest | Blue / Red | Comfort EVA Foam | Comp PFD Life Vest
Description:
UR-20P Pivot Vest Blue/Red

The main feature of a UR-20 Series Vest is the incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest. Instead of forcing a flat piece of EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s chest and back.

Product Features Include:

The UR-20 Side-Entry Vest utilizes ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. Plus, our foam second process is heat and pressure compression, which allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2-inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation. This is a competition level vest for closed course racing or private recreation. USCG Certification is not included.

  • Three-Buckle Closure
  • Adjustable Side Straps
  • Shoulder Velcro Patch
  • Removable "Lanyard Loop" Attachment
  • Dual Rescue Handles, to help pull a downed rider back up on their ski
  • D-Ring for Race Collar Attachment
  • Back Deflector Compatible
  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility and comfort
  • Vest sizing is unisex for men, women, and youth
  • Competition Level Vest (closed course racing, private recreation). No USCG Certification. 
  • SGS Buoyancy Aid Tested (scan QR code to view report)

Title: UR-20P Black Out Vest | Custom Options | Comfort EVA Foam | Comp PDF Life Vest
Description:
UR-20P "Black Out" Competition Vest

COLOR: BLACK VEST / BLACK PLATE

The main feature of a UR-20 Series Vest is the incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest. Instead of forcing a flat piece of EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s chest and back.

This is a Competition Level Vest (for closed course racing and private recreation). While it has been SGS Buoyancy Tested, it does not include USCG Certification. Please know your local regulations regarding vest requirements.

Product Features Include:

The UR-20 Side-Entry Vest utilizes ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. Plus, our foam second process is heat and pressure compression, which allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2-inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation. This is a competition level vest for closed course racing or private recreation. USCG Certification is not included.

  • Three-Buckle Closure
  • Adjustable Side Straps
  • Shoulder Velcro Patch
  • Removable "Lanyard Loop" Attachment
  • Dual Rescue Handles, to help pull a downed rider back up on their ski
  • D-Ring for Race Collar Attachment
  • Back Deflector Compatible
  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility and comfort
  • Vest sizing is unisex for men, women, and youth
  • Competition Level Vest (closed course racing, private recreation). No USCG Certification. 
  • SGS Buoyancy Aid Tested (scan QR code to view report)

Color Kit Option ($34.99 each):

The vest can be customized with a Black Out Color Kit. The kit includes a new name plate, front and back TPR Rubber logos, and lanyard loop in one of 6 colors. Customize the look of your vest to match your ski or your personal style. Each Kit is sold as a set. Custom name/number printing is an additional charge ($40).

Check out this video review of the Color Kit from JD's Water World on Youtube

Customized Name Plate Print Option ($40 Option):

The vest includes a grey incorporated name plate. We offer the option of ordering customized white vinyl lettering (sold separately) that are heat-transferred directly on the back name plate. Show off your Name and Race Number from your local training spot, all the way to the Lake Havasu World Finals. Available in Standard and Moto Fonts. [Note: Customization takes an additional 1-2 weeks and the custom plate is shipped separately from the vest] (Please note: We cannot print profane or offensive customization)

This is not a spine back protection plate, it is a removable piece for customization purposes only. Race Back Protection can be purchased separately.

Description:
Pivot John & Jacket Wetsuit 2 Piece Set - Green

Limited Edition - No additional stock will be available

The Jettribe Wetsuit John & Jacket Race Suit is built, designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility. "S.Tec" neoprene added for improved stretch and durability. Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider.

2 Piece Set - Includes sleeveless john and a long sleeve hooded jacket
  • PWC Manufacturers recommend wetsuits to help protect your skin and body from injury in the event of a fall
  • Jettribe wetsuits have built in movement panels to help a PWC rider flex side-to-side
  • Built with 2.5mm neoprene in the chest, back, and legs (comfortable down to 55F water temps)
Product Features
  • Abrasion resistant silicone print on the knees
  • Durable wire-mesh neoprene in the seat panel
  • Left shoulder velcro entry
  • Ankle zippers for easy on and off
  • 2nd Generation "S.Tec" neoprene for improved stretch and durability. Soft and comfortable.
  • Vivid and Bright Screenprinted Graphics
  • All seams have our interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin
  • Marine-grade zipper on the jacket with built in hood

 

    

Sizing Information: Please take special care to determine the best size for your wetsuit purchase. Use your largest measurement to choose your wetsuit size. For example, if your Height and Weight are Size Large, but your Chest and Waist are a Size X-Large, then X-Large is your best wetsuit size. If you are on the high end of one size's measurements, we always encourage you to order the next larger size. The wetsuit is designed to be a tight fit. Title: UR-20 Circuit Vest | Aqua Blue | Comp Race Vest |
Description:
UR-20P Circuit Vest Aqua Blue

The main feature of a UR-20 Series Vest is the incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest. Instead of forcing a flat piece of EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s chest and back.

Product Features Include:

  • Three-Buckle Closure
  • Adjustable Side Straps
  • Upgraded Velcro Patch attachment on Side Strap
  • Removable "Lanyard Loop" Attachment on Side Strap
  • Triple Rescue Handles, to help pull a downed rider back up on their ski
  • D-Ring for Race Collar Attachment
  • Back Deflector Compatible
  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility and comfort
  • Vest sizing is unisex for men, women, and youth
  • Competition Level Vest (closed course racing, private recreation). No USCG Certification. 
  • SGS Buoyancy Aid Tested (scan QR code to view report)

The UR-20 Side-Entry Vest utilizes ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. Plus, our foam second process is heat and pressure compression, which allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2-inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation. This is a competition level vest for closed course racing or private recreation. USCG Certification is not included.

Title: Circuit 2 Piece Wetsuit Set | Black | John & Jacket
Description:
Circuit John & Jacket Wetsuit 2 Piece Set - Black

The Jettribe Wetsuit John & Jacket Race Suit is built, designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility. "S.Tec" neoprene added for improved stretch and durability. Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider.

2 Piece Set - Includes sleeveless john and a long sleeve jacket
  • PWC Manufacturers recommend wetsuits to help protect your skin and body from injury in the event of a fall
  • Jettribe wetsuits have built in movement panels to help a PWC rider flex side-to-side
  • Built with 2.5mm neoprene in the chest, back, and legs (comfortable in water temps as low as 62-68F)
Product Features
  • Abrasion resistant wire mesh neoprene in the seat and knees
  • Left shoulder velcro entry
  • Ankle zippers for easy on and off
  • 2nd Generation "S.Tec" neoprene for improved stretch and durability. Soft and comfortable.
  • Vivid and Bright Screenprinted Graphics
  • All seams have our interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin
  • Marine-grade zipper on the jacket top

 

    

Sizing Information: Please take special care to determine the best size for your wetsuit purchase. Use your largest measurement to choose your wetsuit size. For example, if your Height and Weight are Size Large, but your Chest and Waist are a Size X-Large, then X-Large is your best wetsuit size. If you are on the high end of one size's measurements, we always encourage you to order the next larger size. The wetsuit is designed to be a tight fit. Please feel free to email, call, or contact us on Live Chat to ask your sizing questions.


Chest and Waist Measurements are the best way to determine your wetsuit size.

Return/Exchange Policy: If the size you receive still does not work for your body type/frame, returns and exchanges may be requested within 30 days of delivery for new, unused wetsuits returned in original condition and original packaging. Wetsuits must follow our wetsuit folding policy to ensure the wetsuit is not creased or damaged in shipping. Link: Wetsuit Return Instructions Returns are subject to inspection upon arrival. Wetsuits that have been used, washed, dirty, stained, or are damaged due to pet hair, smoke exposure, or creased are not eligible for a refund/exchange.

The main feature of a UR-20 Series Vest is the incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest. Instead of forcing a flat piece of EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s chest and back.

Plus, our foam second process is heat and pressure compression, which allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2-inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation. This is a competition level vest for closed course racing or private recreation. USCG Certification is not included.

Title: USCG Circuit Vest | Aqua Blue | Coast Guard Approved CGA Type 3 | Side-Entry Jet Ski Vest
Description:
USCG Circuit Side-Entry Vest - Aqua Blue

The Jettribe USCG (US Coast Guard Approved) Side Entry Vest is IJSBA race legal all over the world. This vest is an excellent all-around vest for riding freestyle, closed-course racing, off-shore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well.

  • US Coast Guard Type 3
  • Dual Rescue Handles (one on each shoulder)
  • IJSBA Race Legal
  • Strength tested at 100 MPH
  • Side-Entry buckle closure
  • Triple 38mm buckles and webbing
  • Removable heavy duty Lanyard Loop D-ring
  • Back Deflector compatible
  • Made of Nylon & EVA Foam
  • Universal fit for men and women

Vest Features

The vest has two incorporated rescue handles unique only to our Jettribe vests. The rescue handles can help pulled a downed rider back up on their ski.  It is wrapped underneath and bar tacked, then finished off with a box stitch for strength.

The side strap has a Jettribe velcro patch attachment. Feel free to change it out for your favorite patch or a country flag (country patches sold separately). Size 4" W x 2.5" H

Size Guide

It is very important to measure your chest size.

Looking for XS & 2XL Sizes? Currently there is no USCG certification for these sizes in this Side-Entry style.

These sizes are available in our Competition Vests section.

In between sizes? We recommend L/XL for adults over 6ft

Description:
Sharpened John & Jacket Wetsuit Set - Red- Jacket Only.

Closeout - No additional sizes will be produced

This is a closeout product: No Warranty/ No Returns

The Jettribe Wetsuit John & Jacket Race Suit is built, designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility:

  • Set includes both the wetsuit sleeveless john, and the long sleeve jacket
  • Built with 3mm panels are for warmth and 2mm panels for high movement areas like the inner arms and legs
  • Vivid and Bright Screen printed Graphics
  • All seams have our interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin
  • Carefully selected neoprene for the right combination of thickness to retain a rider's body heat in various conditions
  • Neoprene is a closed, high density foam made up of thousands of tiny air bubbles (cells) which provide an insulation barrier to slow down the conduction of heat
  • John/Jacket Race Suits are engineered with the understanding that constant rider movement over-generates body heat while in water and open air, as opposed to surf wetsuits that are designed to always be in water

If you are on the high end of one size's measurements, we always encourage you to order the next larger size. The wetsuit is designed to be a tight fit. Please feel free to email, call, or contact us on Live Chat to ask your sizing questions.

Chest and Waist Measurements are the best way to determine your wetsuit size.

Jettribe Inflatable Rescue Board

JTA 24491

 

The Jettribe Rescue Boards are rescue tow sled equipment designed to be towed by a PWC (Jet Ski) for fast rescue. They are lightweight and tough, as well as compact when not in use. The Inflatable construction with Drop=Stitch PVC material makes it much lighter than traditional rescue boards. The towable rescue sled is fast and maneuverable. The tow-behind Jetski rescue board is designed for use behind Personal Water Craft (PWC) to react quickly and arrive on time to a swimmer in trouble or a downed rider on a race course. Also, the towable rescue sled is the perfect equipment for tow-in surfing. Worldwide associations rely on the Rescue Board as their vital rescue equipment such as Peruvian National Police, Surf Rescue Division, China Closed Course PWC Racing, Yamaha of Thailand PWC Safety, and the USA IJSBA West Coast and Mid-America Closed Course Racing.

The main feature of a UR-20 Series Vest is the incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest. Instead of forcing a flat piece of EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s chest and back.

Product Features Include:

  • Three-Buckle Closure
  • Adjustable Side Straps
  • Upgraded Velcro Patch attachment on Side Strap
  • Removable "Lanyard Loop" Attachment on Side Strap
  • Triple Rescue Handles, to help pull a downed rider back up on their ski
  • D-Ring for Race Collar Attachment
  • Back Deflector Compatible
  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility and comfort
  • Vest sizing is unisex for men, women, and youth
  • Competition Level Vest (closed course racing, private recreation). No USCG Certification. 
  • SGS Buoyancy Aid Tested (scan QR code to view report)

The UR-20 Side-Entry Vest utilizes ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. Plus, our foam second process is heat and pressure compression, which allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2-inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation. This is a competition level vest for closed course racing or private recreation. USCG Certification is not included.

Title: USCG Vest | Block | Color: Black (Size: S/M)
Description:
U.S.C.G. Block Side-Entry Vest PWC Jetski Race

Note: This Series has been discontinued.  No additional vest sizes will be available in the future.  

The Jettribe USCG (US Coast Guard Approved) Side Entry Vest is IJSBA race legal all over the world. This vest is an excellent all-around vest for riding freestyle, closed-course racing, off-shore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well. 

It has incorporated rescue handles unique only to our Jettribe race vests.  The rescue handles are wrapped underneath and bar tacked, then finished off with a box stitch. 

Our Jettribe race vests have been proven with top professional racers throughout the world.  Some of the features that separate our vest from the rest are: triple rescue handles, back protection compatible, triple 38mm buckles and webbing, and removable heavy duty PWC lanyard D-ring.  

Jettribe designed and developed the vests using the best materials available. We do recommend that riding equipment be replaced every two seasons.  If there are any signs of fading, discoloration, or drying out of the materials - please, replace it right away.  Sun, water, wet, dry, or salt water are hard on any materials. 

The vest is speed rated and race legal by sanctioned race organizations IJSBA & TJSBA.

  • US Coast Guard Type 3
  • IJSBA Race Legal
  • Strength tested at 100 MPH
  • Side-Entry buckle closure
  • Triple 38mm buckles and webbing
  • Reinforced Triple Rescue Handles
  • Removable heavy duty PWC lanyard D-ring
  • Back Deflector compatible

Title: UR-20 Vest | Recoil | Black | Comp PFD Life Vest (Size: S/M)
Description:
The main feature of a UR-20 Series Vest is the incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest. Instead of forcing a flat piece of EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s chest and back.

Product Features Include:

  • Three-Buckle Closure
  • Adjustable Side Straps
  • Upgraded Velcro Patch attachment on Side Strap
  • Removable "Lanyard Loop" Attachment on Side Strap
  • Triple Rescue Handles, to help pull a downed rider back up on their ski
  • D-Ring for Race Collar Attachment
  • Back Deflector Compatible
  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility and comfort
  • Vest sizing is unisex for men, women, and youth
  • Competition Level Vest (closed course racing, private recreation). No USCG Certification. 
  • SGS Buoyancy Aid Tested (scan QR code to view report)

The UR-20 Side-Entry Vest utilizes ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. Plus, our foam second process is heat and pressure compression, which allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2-inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation. This is a competition level vest for closed course racing or private recreation. USCG Certification is not included.

Description:
U.S.C.G. Circuit Side-Entry Vest PWC Jetski Race

The Jettribe USCG (US Coast Guard Approved) Side Entry Vest is IJSBA race legal all over the world. This vest is an excellent all-around vest for riding freestyle, closed-course racing, off-shore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well. 

It has incorporated rescue handles unique only to our Jettribe race vests.  The rescue handles are wrapped underneath and bar tacked, then finished off with a box stitch. 

Our Jettribe race vests have been proven with top professional racers throughout the world.  Some of the features that separate our vest from the rest are: triple rescue handles, back protection compatible, triple 38mm buckles and webbing, and removable heavy duty PWC lanyard D-ring.  

Jettribe designed and developed the vests using the best materials available. We do recommend that riding equipment be replaced every two seasons.  If there are any signs of fading, discoloration, or drying out of the materials - please, replace it right away.  Sun, water, wet, dry, or salt water are hard on any materials. 

The vest is speed rated and race legal by sanctioned race organizations IJSBA & TJSBA.

Title: Recoil 2 Piece Wetsuit Set | Red | John & Jacket (Size: Large)
Description:
Recoil John & Jacket Wetsuit 2 Piece Set - Red

 

The Jettribe Wetsuit John & Jacket Race Suit is built, designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility. "S.Tec" neoprene added for improved stretch and durability. Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider.

2 Piece Set - Includes sleeveless john and a long sleeve jacket
  • PWC Manufacturers recommend wetsuits to help protect your skin and body from injury in the event of a fall
  • Jettribe wetsuits have built in movement panels to help a PWC rider flex side-to-side
  • Built with 2.5mm neoprene in the chest, back, and legs (comfortable in water temps as low as 62-68F)
Product Features
  • Abrasion resistant wire mesh neoprene in the seat and knees
  • Left shoulder velcro entry
  • Ankle zippers for easy on and off
  • 2nd Generation "S.Tec" neoprene for improved stretch and durability. Soft and comfortable.
  • Vivid and Bright Screenprinted Graphics
  • All seams have our interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin
  • Marine-grade zipper on the jacket top

 

    

 

Sizing Information: Please take special care to determine the best size for your wetsuit purchase. Use your largest measurement to choose your wetsuit size. For example, if your Height and Weight are Size Large, but your Chest and Waist are a Size X-Large, then X-Large is your best wetsuit size. If you are on the high end of one size's measurements, we always encourage you to order the next larger size. The wetsuit is designed to be a tight fit. Please feel free to email, call, or contact us on Live Chat to ask your sizing questions.


Chest and Waist Measurements are the best way to determine your wetsuit size.

Return/Exchange Policy: If the size you receive still does not work for your body type/frame, returns and exchanges may be requested within 30 days of delivery for new, unused wetsuits returned in original condition and original packaging. Wetsuits must follow our wetsuit folding policy to ensure the wetsuit is not creased or damaged in shipping. Link: Wetsuit Return Instructions Returns are subject to inspection upon arrival. Wetsuits that have been used, washed, dirty, stained, or are damaged due to pet hair, smoke exposure, or creased are not eligible for a refund/exchange.

Title: UR-20 Circuit Life Vest, Color: Green/Aqua (Size: Small/Medium)
Description:
UR-20P Circuit Vest Green & Aqua

The main feature of a UR-20 Series Vest is the incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest. Instead of forcing a flat piece of EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s chest and back.

 

Product Features Include:

  • Three-Buckle Closure
  • Adjustable Side Straps
  • Upgraded Velcro Patch attachment on Side Strap
  • Removable "Lanyard Loop" Attachment on Side Strap
  • Triple Rescue Handles, to help pull a downed rider back up on their ski
  • D-Ring for Race Collar Attachment
  • Back Deflector Compatible
  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility and comfort
  • Vest sizing is unisex for men, women, and youth
  • Competition Level Vest (closed course racing, private recreation). No USCG Certification. 
  • SGS Buoyancy Aid Tested (scan QR code to view report)

The UR-20 Side-Entry Vest utilizes ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. Plus, our foam second process is heat and pressure compression, which allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2-inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation. This is a competition level vest for closed course racing or private recreation. USCG Certification is not included.

The Jettribe Wetsuit is built, designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility.  New for 2020 is our new "S-Tek" neoprene for improved stretch and durability.  Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider.

  • Built with 3mm panels are for warmth and 2mm panels for high movement areas like the inner arms and legs
  • New 2020 "S-Tek" neoprene for improved stretch and durability; built for the PWC riders stance

  • All seams have our interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin

  • John/Jacket Race Suits are engineered with the understanding that constant rider movement over-generates body heat while in water and open air, as opposed to surf wetsuits that are designed to always be in water

Description:
UR-20P Circuit Vest Grey

The main feature of a UR-20 Series Vest is the incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest. Instead of forcing a flat piece of EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s chest and back.

 

Product Features Include:

  • Three-Buckle Closure
  • Adjustable Side Straps
  • Upgraded Velcro Patch attachment on Side Strap

Plus, our foam second process is heat and pressure compression, which allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2-inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation. This is a competition level vest for closed course racing or private recreation. USCG Certification is not included.

Description:
Block John & Jacket Wetsuit 2 Piece Set - Red - Scratch and Dent - Small Hole in Shoulder of Jacket

 

The Jettribe Wetsuit John & Jacket Race Suit is built, designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility. "S.Tec" neoprene added for improved stretch and durability. Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider.

2 Piece Set - Includes sleeveless john and a long sleeve jacket
  • PWC Manufacturers recommend wetsuits to help protect your skin and body from injury in the event of a fall
  • Jettribe wetsuits have built in movement panels to help a PWC rider flex side-to-side
  • Built with 2.5mm neoprene in the chest, back, and legs (comfortable in water temps as low as 62-68F)
Product Features
  • Abrasion resistant wire mesh neoprene in the seat and knees
  • Left shoulder velcro entry
  • Ankle zippers for easy on and off
  • 2nd Generation "S.Tec" neoprene for improved stretch and durability. Soft and comfortable.
  • Vivid and Bright Screenprinted Graphics
  • All seams have our interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin
  • Marine-grade zipper on the jacket top

 

    

 

Sizing Information: Please take special care to determine the best size for your wetsuit purchase. Use your largest measurement to choose your wetsuit size. For example, if your Height and Weight are Size Large, but your Chest and Waist are a Size X-Large, then X-Large is your best wetsuit size. If you are on the high end of one size's measurements, we always encourage you to order the next larger size. The wetsuit is designed to be a tight fit. Please feel free to email, call, or contact us on Live Chat to ask your sizing questions.


Chest and Waist Measurements are the best way to determine your wetsuit size.

Return/Exchange Policy: If the size you receive still does not work for your body type/frame, returns and exchanges may be requested within 30 days of delivery for new, unused wetsuits returned in original condition and original packaging. Wetsuits must follow our wetsuit folding policy to ensure the wetsuit is not creased or damaged in shipping. Link: Wetsuit Return Instructions Returns are subject to inspection upon arrival. Wetsuits that have been used, washed, dirty, stained, or are damaged due to pet hair, smoke exposure, or creased are not eligible for a refund/exchange.

Title: UR-20 JTR SERIES VEST (Orange / Blue)
Description:
UR-20 JTR Series Vest Orange / Royal Blue

The main feature of a UR-20 Series Vest is the incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest. Instead of forcing a flat piece of EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s chest and back.

Product Features Include:

  • Three-Buckle Closure
  • Adjustable Side Straps
  • Upgraded Velcro Patch attachment on Side Strap
  • Removable "Lanyard Loop" Attachment on Side Strap
  • Triple Rescue Handles, to help pull a downed rider back up on their ski
  • D-Ring for Race Collar Attachment
  • Back Deflector Compatible
  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility and comfort
  • Vest sizing is unisex for men, women, and youth
  • Competition Level Vest (closed course racing, private recreation). No USCG Certification. 
  • SGS Buoyancy Aid Tested (scan QR code to view report)

The UR-20 Side-Entry Vest utilizes ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. Plus, our foam second process is heat and pressure compression, which allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2-inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation. This is a competition level vest for closed course racing or private recreation. USCG Certification is not included.

Title: UR-20 JTR SERIES VEST (Black)
Description:
UR-20 JTR Series Vest Black

The main feature of a UR-20 Series Vest is the incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest. Instead of forcing a flat piece of EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s chest and back.

Product Features Include:

  • Three-Buckle Closure
  • Adjustable Side Straps
  • Upgraded Velcro Patch attachment on Side Strap
  • Removable "Lanyard Loop" Attachment on Side Strap
  • Triple Rescue Handles, to help pull a downed rider back up on their ski
  • D-Ring for Race Collar Attachment
  • Back Deflector Compatible
  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility and comfort
  • Vest sizing is unisex for men, women, and youth
  • Competition Level Vest (closed course racing, private recreation). No USCG Certification. 
  • SGS Buoyancy Aid Tested (scan QR code to view report)

The UR-20 Side-Entry Vest utilizes ink fusion technology, instead of traditional silkscreen ink. Plus, our foam second process is heat and pressure compression, which allows us to take a 4-inch EVA foam panel and compress it down to a 2-inch thickness. This process allows for a lighter and more comfortable race vest with maximum flotation. This is a competition level vest for closed course racing or private recreation. USCG Certification is not included.

Title: JTR Series 2 Piece Wetsuit Set | Red / Aqua | John & Jacket
Description:
New JTR Series 2-pc Wetsuit- Red / Aqua

The Jettribe Wetsuit John & Jacket Race Suit is built, designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility. "S.Tec" neoprene added for improved stretch and durability. Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider.

2 Piece Set - Includes sleeveless john and a long sleeve jacket
  • PWC Manufacturers recommend wetsuits to help protect your skin and body from injury in the event of a fall
  • Jettribe wetsuits have built in movement panels to help a PWC rider flex side-to-side
  • Built with 2.5mm neoprene in the chest, back, and legs (comfortable in water temps as low as 62-68F)
Top Features:
  • Abrasion resistant wire mesh neoprene in the seat and knees
  • Left shoulder velcro entry
  • Ankle zippers for easy on and off
  • 2nd Generation "S.Tec" neoprene for improved stretch and durability. Soft and comfortable.
  • Vivid and Bright Screenprinted Graphics
  • All seams have our interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin
  • Marine-grade zipper on the jacket top
Sizing Information:

Please take special care to determine the best size for your wetsuit purchase. Use your largest measurement to choose your wetsuit size. For example, if your Height and Weight are Size Large, but your Chest and Waist are a Size X-Large, then X-Large is your best wetsuit size. If you are on the high end of one size's measurements, we always encourage you to order the next larger size. The wetsuit is designed to be a tight fit. Please feel free to email, call, or contact us on Live Chat to ask your sizing questions.

 

Chest and Waist Measurements are the best way to determine your wetsuit size.

The extra high neoprene cut of the GRB 3.0 boot helps keep the ankle comfortable, and help protect from sand and rocks. The boot features a marine-grade zipper entry for easy slip-on or off, and two adjustable velcro straps for a snug fit. We have also upgraded the reinforced front of the toe area to help grip-in foot holds and provide extra toe protection.

  • Marine-Grade front zipper entry for easy slip-on and off
  • Dual velcro front closure for custom comfort
  • Mesh flow through panels allows water to drain quickly
  • Heavy duty TPR Rubber Logos
  • 4-Way Stretch Neoprene combined with high ankle support for comfort, protection, and to help keep out rocks and sand
  • Extra reinforced outsole sewing around perimeter of the boot
  • Pre-curved sole with arch support for maximum comfort

To ensure the best fit for your custom wetsuit, please follow these measurement instructions:

Title: Custom Wetsuit JTR Series| Red | John & Jacket
Description:
Custom JTR Series Ride Suits - Red

The Jettribe Wetsuit John & Jacket Race Suit is built, designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility. "S.Tec" neoprene added for improved stretch and durability. Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider.

2 Piece Set - Includes sleeveless john and a long sleeve jacket
  • PWC Manufacturers recommend wetsuits to help protect your skin and body from injury in the event of a fall
  • Jettribe wetsuits have built in movement panels to help a PWC rider flex side-to-side
  • Built with 2.5mm neoprene in the chest, back, and legs (comfortable in water temps as low as 62-68F)
Product Features
  • 2.5mm (S-Tec) Neoprene: Material used for the upper chest section.
  • Sleeveless John: The overall style of the wetsuit.
  • Velcro Shoulder Closure: Located on the Left shoulder of the garment
  • Silkscreen Graphics: Branded "JTR" logos on the chest and lower leg.
  • 4-Way Stretch Movement Panels: Located along the side of the torso for flexibility.
  • 2.5mm Neoprene Warmth Panel: Main core paneling for thermal protection.
  • Abrasion Resistant Wire Mesh Neoprene Rear Seating Panel: Durable material reinforced for the seating area.
  • Interlocking Flat Stitch: Used for durable, low-profile seams throughout the suit.
  • 4-Way Stretch Inseam Panel: Flexible paneling located at the inner thigh.
  • Abrasion Resistant Wire Mesh Knee Neoprene: Reinforced protection for the knee area.
  • Leg Zippers Opening: Located at the ankles for easier entry and exit. 
Custom Wetsuit Sizing Guide

How to Measure

To ensure the best fit for your custom wetsuit, please follow these measurement instructions:

  • Chest: Measure under arms around the fullest part of the chest. Be sure to keep the tape level across your back and comfortably loose.

  • Shoulders: Place the measuring tape on the edge of one shoulder and drag it along over the back of your neck to the edge of your other shoulder.

  • Height: Place the measuring tape at the flattest part of the foot and drag it to the top of the head.

Please feel free to email, call, or contact us on Live Chat to ask your sizing questions.

Return/Exchange Policy: No return on custom products.

Title: *New* Factory Custom JTR Series| UR-20 Vest | Black | Your Name, # and Photo
Description:
UR-20 JTR Series Vest - Black

PWC 25th Anniversary Edition- UR-20P Team Rider Side-Entry Life Vest. The main feature of a UR-20 Series Vest is the incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest. Instead of forcing a flat piece of EVA foam to wrap around a rider’s body, the pre-formed mold adds the ultimate in flexibility to conform to the rider’s chest and back. The Jettribe UR-20P Side Entry Vest is an excellent all-around vest for free riding, freestyle, closed course racing, offshore endurance racing and naturally, for recreation PWC riding as well. This vest is SGS buoyancy rated to meet or exceed USCG flotation standards. Our proprietary process compresses a 4-inch EVA foam down to 2 inches for a light more comfortable vest with maximum flotation.

  • Includes a personalized name and race number with custom body and shadow colors. 
  • Features an option to upload your own JPEG photo for a unique, personalized background.

  • Removable "Lanyard Loop" Attachment on Side Strap
  • Triple Rescue Handles, to help pull a downed rider back up on their ski
  • D-Ring for Race Collar Attachment
  • Back Deflector Compatible
  • Pre Formed molded inner EVA foam for the ultimate flexibility and comfort
  • Vest sizing is unisex for men, women, and youth

Title: *New* Factory Custom JTR Series Wetsuit | Pink | John Only
Description:
Custom JTR Series Ride Suits - Pink

The Jettribe Wetsuit John & Jacket Race Suit is built, designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility. "S.Tec" neoprene added for improved stretch and durability. Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider.

Sleeveless John Only - Features a stand-alone sleeveless john for maximum mobility
  • PWC Manufacturers recommend wetsuits to help protect your skin and body from injury in the event of a fall
  • Jettribe wetsuits have built in movement panels to help a PWC rider flex side-to-side
  • Built with 2.5mm neoprene in the chest, back, and legs (comfortable in water temps as low as 62-68F)
  • Complete Your Set — Looking for the full suit? Click here for the Whole John & Jacket 2-piece variation
Product Features
  • 2.5mm (S-Tec) Neoprene: Material used for the upper chest section.
  • Sleeveless John: The overall style of the wetsuit.
  • Velcro Shoulder Closure: Located on the Left shoulder of the garment
  • Silkscreen Graphics: Branded "JTR" logos on the chest and lower leg.
  • 4-Way Stretch Movement Panels: Located along the side of the torso for flexibility.
  • 2.5mm Neoprene Warmth Panel: Main core paneling for thermal protection.
  • Abrasion Resistant Wire Mesh Neoprene Rear Seating Panel: Durable material reinforced for the seating area.
  • Interlocking Flat Stitch: Used for durable, low-profile seams throughout the suit.
  • 4-Way Stretch Inseam Panel: Flexible paneling located at the inner thigh.
  • Abrasion Resistant Wire Mesh Knee Neoprene: Reinforced protection for the knee area.
  • Leg Zippers Opening: Located at the ankles for easier entry and exit. 
Custom Wetsuit Sizing Guide

How to Measure

To ensure the best fit for your custom wetsuit, please follow these measurement instructions:

  • Chest: Measure under arms around the fullest part of the chest. Be sure to keep the tape level across your back and comfortably loose.

  • Shoulders: Place the measuring tape on the edge of one shoulder and drag it along over the back of your neck to the edge of your other shoulder.

  • Height: Place the measuring tape at the flattest part of the foot and drag it to the top of the head.

Please feel free to email, call, or contact us on Live Chat to ask your sizing questions.

Return/Exchange Policy: No return on custom products.

Description:
JTR Series 2 Piece Wetsuit Set | Grey/Black | John & Jacket (Large)

 

The Jettribe Wetsuit is built, designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility.  Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider.

  • Vivid and Bright Screenprinted Graphics
  • 2nd Generation "S-Tek" Neoprene with improved softness, stretch, and durability. Built for the PWC riders stance
  • All seams have our interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin
  • Neoprene is a closed, high density foam made up of thousands of tiny air bubbles (cells) which provide an insulation barrier to slow down the conduction of heat
  • Engineered with the understanding that constant rider movement over-generates body heat while in water and open air, as opposed to surf wetsuits that are designed to always be in water
  • Please review the "Chest Size" and "Arm Inseam" in the below chart to see if this size will work for your frame.

Sizing Information: Please take special care to determine the best size for your wetsuit john purchase. Use your largest measurement to choose your size. Your Waist Measurement is the best way to determine your wetsuit john size.  The wetsuit john is designed to be a tight fit. Please feel free to email, call, or contact us on Live Chat to ask your sizing questions.

RS-25 Side Entry Impact Vest - Purple / Grey

 

 

Jettribe 25th Anniversary Edition-RS-25 Side Entry Impact Race Vest. Updated style and enhanced features make this vest excellent for closed course racing , offshore endurance racing , and naturally for recreation PWC riding as well. The most important feature is the built-in high density, EVA compression molded chest plate. The plate in RS-25 offers more protection than traditional life vests to help reduce effects from chest Impacts. Instead of forcing a flat piece of EVA foam to wrap around a rider's body, the pre-formed mold allows the vest to flex and conform to each rider's chest and back. The main feature is incorporated pre-molded foam in the front and back of the vest. 

The Vest is SGS buoyancy rated to meet or exceed USCG floatation standards. Our proprietary process compresses a 4-inch EVA foam down to 2-inches for a lighter , more comfortable vest with maximum flotation.

  • Side-Entry Impact Design optimized for racing and recreation 
  • High-Density EVA Chest Plate for superior impact protection
  • SGS Buoyancy Rated to make meet or exceed USCG standards
  • 4-inch EVA compressed to 2-inch for lightweight, maximum flotation

  • Back Deflector Compatible for integrated spinal safety

Description:
New JTR Series 2-pc Wetsuit- Aqua / Orange

The Jettribe Wetsuit John & Jacket Race Suit is built, designed and engineered for the riders' maximum comfort, flexibility, warmth and mobility. "S.Tec" neoprene added for improved stretch and durability. Our wetsuits are built to stretch and move with a PWC rider.

2 Piece Set - Includes sleeveless john and a long sleeve jacket
  • PWC Manufacturers recommend wetsuits to help protect your skin and body from injury in the event of a fall
  • Jettribe wetsuits have built in movement panels to help a PWC rider flex side-to-side
  • Built with 2.5mm neoprene in the chest, back, and legs (comfortable in water temps as low as 62-68F)
Top Features:
  • Abrasion resistant wire mesh neoprene in the seat and knees
  • Left shoulder velcro entry
  • Ankle zippers for easy on and off
  • 2nd Generation "S.Tec" neoprene for improved stretch and durability. Soft and comfortable.
  • Vivid and Bright Screenprinted Graphics
  • All seams have our interlocking flat stitch to provide a watertight seal and maximum comfort against the skin
  • Marine-grade zipper on the jacket top
 
Sizing Information:

Please take special care to determine the best size for your wetsuit purchase. Use your largest measurement to choose your wetsuit size. For example, if your Height and Weight are Size Large, but your Chest and Waist are a Size X-Large, then X-Large is your best wetsuit size. If you are on the high end of one size's measurements, we always encourage you to order the next larger size. The wetsuit is designed to be a tight fit. Please feel free to email, call, or contact us on Live Chat to ask your sizing questions.

 

Chest and Waist Measurements are the best way to determine your wetsuit size.

Title: TwoTone Tour Coat | Grey / Black | Oversized Neoprene Jacket | PWC Jet Ski Gear
Description:
TwoTone Tour Coat | Grey / Black

 

Jettribe Tour Coats are purposely oversized to be worn over your life jacket and vest. Designed to keep you warm on the ski or between jet ski rides. No need to take off layers while wearing the coat. Pre-curved elbow joints help provide more comfort and flexibility. Order in the same size as your wetsuit.

Features Include:
  • Designed for those chilly days on or off the water
  • Made as an additional overlayer to help keep your core temperature high, primarily in your chest area
  • Protects from water splashes while on your ski and the cold, high winds when flying across the water at 80MPH
  • Oversized cut to be worn over the life vest and wetsuit
  • Pre-Curved elbow joints for added comfort and flexibility
  • Proprietary compression process makes 5mm neoprene into 3.5mm for a lighter feel and better cold protection
  • Sizing Information: Order coat in the same size as your wetsuit. Coat is oversized to fit over a wetsuit and vest
Designed To Be Worn Over Wetsuit and Vest

The oversized cut is already sized to fit over your vest. Order the same size as your wetsuit. The back has an extended cut for "no plumber's crack."
